jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Professional and experienced Massage Therapist to join the Spa & Wellness team of a leading 5-star luxury hotel in Saudi Arabia.

The Massage Therapist will be responsible for delivering high-quality massage and body treatments while providing exceptional, personalized guest service. The successful candidate should have strong knowledge of massage techniques, spa treatments, guest safety, hygiene standards, and massage contraindications.

The role requires a professional and service-oriented individual who can create a comfortable, safe, and relaxing environment for guests while maintaining the high standards expected within a luxury hotel and spa.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide professional massage services using appropriate techniques, products, and massage tools.
  • Perform body treatments such as body scrubs, wraps, hydrotherapy, and other treatments according to training and spa standards.
  • Consult with guests before treatments to understand their needs, preferences, and expectations.
  • Assess guest needs and identify relevant massage contraindications, including allergies, pregnancy, high blood pressure, and other conditions requiring treatment modification.
  • Confirm the guest's name, treatment, and preferences before beginning the service.
  • Regularly check with guests throughout the treatment to ensure comfort, safety, temperature, positioning, and appropriate massage pressure.
  • Prepare and arrange treatment rooms, workstations, equipment, products, towels, and drapes before each appointment.
  • Monitor and maintain the daily treatment schedule and ensure services are completed within the allocated time.
  • Check appointment schedules regularly for updates and changes.
  • Welcome and professionally escort guests to and from treatment rooms, changing areas, relaxation areas, or their next appointment.
  • Offer appropriate spa amenities such as water, juice, or other available refreshments.
  • Maintain high standards of cleanliness, hygiene, sanitation, and disinfection throughout the treatment area.
  • Clean, maintain, and properly sanitize massage tools and equipment.
  • Dispose of used linens and waste correctly and ensure necessary supplies are available.
  • Check equipment for proper functioning and report defects, damage, or safety concerns to management.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of massage techniques, spa treatments, industry trends, and current practices.
  • Maintain knowledge of spa operating procedures, treatment menus, services, facilities, promotions, and products.
  • Recommend and promote appropriate spa treatments and retail products according to guest needs.
  • Develop positive relationships with guests and contribute to maintaining a strong client base.
  • Maintain guest treatment records, history, and preferences where required.
  • Deliver a warm, professional, and personalized guest experience consistent with 5-star service standards.
  • Listen and respond positively to guest questions, concerns, and requests.
  • Maintain strict guest privacy and confidentiality.
  • Handle inappropriate guest behavior professionally in accordance with hotel procedures and immediately inform the supervisor/manager when required.
  • Follow all hotel and spa policies, procedures, health and safety requirements, and security standards.
  • Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe working conditions immediately to the supervisor/manager.
  • Maintain a clean, hygienic, professional uniform and personal appearance.
  • Work cooperatively with other spa and hotel team members.
  • Perform other reasonable duties assigned by the supervisor or management.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• 4 to 5 year of relevant professional massage/spa experience.
  • Experience in a 5-star hotel, luxury spa, resort, or wellness center is highly preferred.
  • Technical, trade, or vocational qualification in Massage Therapy, Spa Therapy, or a related field is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of professional massage techniques and body treatments.
  • Good understanding of massage contraindications and guest safety.
  • Knowledge of hygiene, sanitation, sterilization, and spa safety procedures.
  • Strong customer-service and interpersonal skills.
  • Good English communication skills.
  • Professional appearance, positive attitude, integrity, dependability, and adaptability.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage treatment schedules.
  • Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods and perform the physical requirements of the role.
  • Relevant massage/spa certification or license where applicable.

Core Skills

Massage Therapy | Guest Service | Spa Treatments | Customer Care | Massage Contraindications | Hygiene & Sanitation | Safety | Communication | Teamwork | Time Management | Spa Product Knowledge | Upselling

 

Must be immediate joiner.

Should have transferable Iqama.

  • Professional and supportive work environment
  • Opportunities for growth within a reputed international brand

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
The Maintenance Technician (Mechatronics) is responsible for the upkeep, troubleshooting, and repair of
mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and automated/control systems used across SELA's production
workshop, event structures, kinetic sets, staging automation, and attraction-type installations. He/she works across preventive and reactive maintenance, ensuring machinery, tools, and automated equipment remain safe, reliable, and available for fabrication and live show operations. This is a hands-on technical role combining mechanical, electrical, and PLC/controls knowledge, suited to someone who can diagnose faults quickly and keep production and event equipment running with zero downtime during show-critical periods.

Key Responsibilities

1. Preventive & Reactive Maintenance
• Maintenance Planning: Develop and follow preventive maintenance schedules for workshop machinery
(CNC routers, saws, welding equipment, compressors) and event/show equipment (motion bases, automation rigs, motorized scenic elements).
• Inspection & Servicing: Perform routine inspection, lubrication, cleaning, calibration, and adjustment of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems to prevent breakdowns.
• Fault Diagnosis & Repair: Diagnose and repair faults across mechanical assemblies, motors, gearboxes, sensors, actuators, and control systems, minimizing equipment downtime.
• Emergency Response: Respond promptly to breakdown calls during fabrication, load-in, and live show windows, prioritizing show-critical and safety-critical equipment.

2. Mechatronics & Controls
• Automation Systems: Install, test, and maintain automated and motion-control systems (PLC-driven show
automation, motorized rigging, kinetic set pieces) used in event productions.
• Electrical & Electronic Systems: Troubleshoot PLC I/O, sensors, VFDs (variable frequency drives), control panels, and low-voltage wiring associated with automated equipment.
• Hydraulics & Pneumatics: Maintain and repair hydraulic and pneumatic systems used in staging, lifts, and motion equipment, including hoses, cylinders, valves, and pumps.
• Testing & Commissioning: Support testing and commissioning of new equipment, automated set pieces, and machinery before workshop or on-site deployment.

3. Safety, Compliance & Documentation
• Safety Compliance: Follow lock-out/tag-out (LOTO), electrical safety, and machine guarding procedures at all times; ensure equipment meets relevant safety standards before use.
• Risk Awareness: Identify and report unsafe equipment conditions and support Risk Assessments/Method
Statements (RAMS) for automated or motorized installations.
• Maintenance Records: Maintain accurate logs of maintenance activity, repairs, spare parts usage, and equipment performance history for each machine and automated system.
• Spares & Inventory: Monitor spare parts stock for critical machinery and automation components, flagging reorder needs ahead of major productions.

4. Team & Cross-functional Support
• Workshop Support: Work closely with the Installation Team Leader, Electrical Team Leader, and fabrication crew to keep tools and machinery production-ready.
• Knowledge Sharing: Provide basic troubleshooting guidance and safe operating instruction to workshop and site staff using mechanized or automated equipment.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
Qualifications & Skills
• Education: Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechatronics Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, Automation, or a related technical discipline.
• Experience: 3+ years of hands-on maintenance experience in mechatronics, industrial automation, amusement/attraction ride maintenance, theatrical/show automation, or a similar workshop or production
environment.
• Technical Skills: Working knowledge of PLCs (Siemens, Allen-Bradley, or equivalent), motor control systems, VFDs, hydraulics, pneumatics, and mechanical power transmission (gearboxes, belts, chains, bearings).
• Diagnostic Tools: Proficiency using multimeters, diagnostic software, and hand/power tools for mechanical and electrical fault-finding.
• Safety Certifications: Relevant electrical/mechanical H&S certifications (e.g., IOSH, NEBOSH, or equivalent local certification) preferred.
• Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving under time pressure, methodical fault-finding approach, and ability to work independently during show-critical window

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
The Detailing Engineer sits within SELA's fabrication and production workshop, converting design concepts, 3D
renders, and structural/architectural drawings into fully dimensioned, buildable shop drawings for event sets,
exhibition stands, scenic elements, staging, and structures. He/she is the technical bridge between the Design
department and the Workshop floor, ensuring every fabricated piece is engineered for accuracy, material efficiency, structural integrity, and safe rigging/installation before a single cut is made. This is a detail-critical, deadline-driven role requiring strong CAD/3D modeling skills combined with practical knowledge of fabrication methods used in live events.

Key Responsibilities

1. Detailing & Technical Drawing
• Shop Drawing Production: Convert approved concept designs, 3D renders, and architectural drawings into detailed 2D fabrication drawings and cutting lists for carpentry, metalwork, and scenic elements.
• 3D Modeling: Build accurate 3D models (AutoCAD, SketchUp, Tekla, Solidworks, or equivalent) of sets, stands, and structures to validate dimensions, tolerances, and assembly sequence prior to production.
• Material & BOQ Take-off: Generate precise bills of quantities and cut lists for timber, steel, aluminum, MDF, acrylic, and other fabrication materials to minimize wastage and support accurate procurement.
• Structural Detailing: Detail load-bearing elements, connections, weld points, and fixings for platforms, trusses, staging, and rigging points, ensuring designs are structurally sound and code-compliant.
• Clash Detection: Cross-check drawings against MEP, AV, lighting, and rigging layouts to identify and resolve clashes before fabrication begins.

2. Production Support & Coordination
• Workshop Liaison: Work directly with the Installation Team Leader, carpenters, welders, and fabricators to clarify drawings, resolve on-the-shop-floor queries, and update details based on practical build constraints.
• Design Liaison: Coordinate with Designers and Project Managers to confirm design intent, obtain approvals on technical revisions, and communicate any design changes required for buildability.
• As-Built Updates: Revise and reissue drawings to reflect on-site or in-workshop modifications, maintaining an accurate as-built record for each project.
• CNC & Machine Files: Prepare CNC cutting/routing files and machine-ready outputs where applicable, to streamline pre-fabrication in the workshop.

3. Quality & Compliance
• Design Validation: Verify that all detailed drawings meet client specifications, structural safety margins, and applicable Saudi building and event safety codes.
• Documentation Control: Maintain organized, version-controlled drawing registers and issue drawings through proper revision and approval workflows.
• Continuous Improvement: Identify recurring detailing issues or fabrication inefficiencies and recommend standardized details, templates, or jigs to improve workshop throughput.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
Qualifications & Skills
• Education: Bachelor's degree or diploma in Mechanical/Civil/Structural Engineering, Architecture, Industrial Design, or a related technical field.
• Experience: 3+ years of detailing/drafting experience in event production, exhibition stand fabrication, scenic/theatrical construction, steel detailing, or a similar workshop-based manufacturing environment.
• Software Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD and SketchUp; working knowledge of Tekla Structures, Solidworks, Rhino, or 3ds Max is an advantage.
• Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of carpentry, metalwork, rigging, and structural connections, along with material properties and fabrication tolerances.
• Standards Awareness: Familiarity with structural safety margins, load calculations, and relevant Saudi/international codes applicable to temporary event structures.
• Soft Skills: High attention to detail, strong spatial visualization, ability to work under pressure against tight
production deadlines, and clear communication with both design and shop-floor teams.

The Electrical Team Leader for the fabrication and production workshop is responsible for the safe, code-compliant, and on-schedule delivery of all electrical works across SELA's event, exhibition, and show productions — from workshop pre-build through final on-site power-up and strike. He/she will coordinate with the Installation, Rigging, AV, and Design teams to ensure that power distribution, show lighting circuits, control cabling, and electrical fit-outs are built, tested, transported, and installed to the highest safety and quality standards, on time and within budget. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring strong technical proficiency in electrical systems for live events, combined with the ability to lead and develop a site-based electrical crew.

Key Responsibilities
1. Production & Supervision

  • Workflow Management: Plan and schedule electrical works for each project, aligning with the overall production and installation timeline.
  • Pre-fabrication & Testing: Ensure all power distribution boards, cable looms, control panels, and lighting/electrical assemblies are built, tested (PAT/continuity/load testing), and signed off in the workshop before dispatch to venue.
  • Packing & Loading: Supervise the safe packing, labelling, and loading of cables, distros, fixtures, and electrical equipment to prevent damage or loss in transit.
  • Resource Management: Monitor manpower, electrical materials, consumables, and tools, and requisition or secure them as required to avoid site delays.
  • Quality Control: Inspect all electrical installations, temporary power distribution, and lighting/AV power circuits to ensure compliance with design specifications, SASO/Saudi Electrical Code requirements, and client quality standards.

2. Health, Safety & Compliance

  • Risk Management: Develop and enforce Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS) for temporary power, generator hook-ups, and on-site electrical installations.
  • Safety Enforcement: Ensure all team members comply with Health & Safety policies, including LOTO (lock-out/tag-out) procedures, RCD/earthing protection, safe use of PPE, and safe handling of power tools and test equipment.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all temporary electrical installations meet Saudi Electrical Code, civil defense, and venue-specific electrical safety requirements for public events.
  • Housekeeping: Maintain a clean, organized, and safe workshop and site environment (5S standards), with cabling and distribution runs managed to eliminate trip and fire hazards.

3. Team Leadership & Communication

  • On-site Leadership: Lead daily site electrical operations and allocate tasks to electricians and technicians, ensuring efficient use of manpower to meet load-in and show-ready deadlines.
  • Coaching & Mentoring: Train and mentor junior electricians and technicians on power distribution, cable management, lighting circuits, and tool/equipment safety.
  • Performance Monitoring: Conduct daily toolbox talks and team briefings, monitor crew performance, and provide feedback to improve efficiency and reduce rework or snags.
  • Project Liaison: Liaise with production managers, lighting/AV designers, riggers, and site management to provide progress updates, resolve technical bottlenecks, and ensure a seamless power-up for every show or activation

  • Blueprint Interpretation: Ability to read and interpret electrical single-line diagrams, power plans, CAD drawings, and design specifications.
  • Safety Certifications: Relevant electrical and H&S qualifications (e.g., licensed electrician certification, IOSH/NEBOSH, or equivalent local certification recognized in Saudi Arabia).

Job Title: Cost Controller

Department: Cost Control / Commercial

Experience Required: 5–10 Years

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Cost Controller to join our team in Riyadh. The successful candidate will be responsible for monitoring, analyzing, and reporting project costs, ensuring expenditures remain aligned with approved budgets and supporting management with timely financial insights throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and update project cost reports, cost-to-complete, and estimate-at-completion forecasts using RIB Candy.
  • Monitor project expenditures against approved budgets and identify cost variances.
  • Perform root cause analysis and recommend corrective actions.
  • Review and validate subcontractor and supplier invoices.
  • Maintain Cost Breakdown Structures (CBS) and Work Breakdown Structures (WBS).
  • Track variation orders, claims, and provisional sums.
  • Support monthly project cost reviews and management reporting.
  • Reconcile project costs with finance and accounting records.
  • Assist in budget preparation and cash flow forecasting.
  • Coordinate with project managers, planning, procurement, and site teams.

Role Summary:

Responsible for preparing accurate cost estimates, BOQs, and tender submissions for mechanical and electrical building services projects within the tendering department.

  • Prepare detailed cost estimates and BOQs for MEP works

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE 

Essential 

  • BSc or BEng / HNDE in Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Construction Economics, or a closely related discipline. 

  • Minimum 9–11 years of post-graduate experience in a QS / Estimation role within the construction industry (contractor side).

  • Strong numerical and analytical skills with high attention to detail. 

  • Competent in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel. 

  • Advance knowledge in Candy Cost Estimation tool. 

  • Experience in a specific sector such as residential, commercial, infrastructure, fit-out, or civils. 

CORE COMPETENCIES 

  • Commercial awareness and sound contractual understanding. 

  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, both written and verbal. 

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously. 

  • Self-motivated and able to work independently as well as within a team. 

  • Proactive problem-solving approach with a focus on value and risk management. 

  • Professional integrity and commitment to delivering high-quality outputs.

Rime is a pioneering Saudi tech company specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Computer Vision. We are on a mission to put an end to "operational blindness" for multi-branch businesses, particularly in the retail and F&B sectors.

By seamlessly integrating with existing CCTV cameras, our intelligent platform transforms ordinary video streams into real-time, actionable insights. We replace delayed manual reporting with proactive AI agents that monitor and analyze daily operations around the clock.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text: At Rime, we are on a massive mission to empower businesses and optimize our clients' operational processes by transforming real-time video streams and sensor data into actionable insights. As a Senior Computer Vision Engineer, you will be at the very heart of our core technology. You will lead the design, development, and deployment of state-of-the-art computer vision models that analyze complex environments in real-time. From detecting queue lengths and analyzing customer behavior to verifying uniform compliance and hygiene standards, your algorithms will serve as the "eyes" that put an end to operational blindness for our clients.

The Production Team Leader is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the event production workshop, ensuring that scenic elements, structures, custom displays, and related furniture are fabricated efficiently, safely, and to high-quality standards. The Installation Team Leader is the on-site operational lead responsible for directing a crew of installation technicians in the safe, accurate, and timely assembly, installation, and derig of custom event builds, props, structures, and themed environments. This role bridges workshop production and live event delivery — ensuring that every build reaches site on time, is installed to specification, and is struck efficiently post-event. The Team Leader is the first point of accountability on site and must command both technical credibility and strong crew management skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Crew Leadership: Lead, brief, and direct a team of 5–15 installation technicians on site, allocating tasks based on skill set and project priority.
  • Site Planning & Preparation: Study installation drawings, site plans, and build schedules in advance; conduct pre-installation site surveys and identify access, rigging, or structural constraints.
  • Installation Execution: Oversee and actively participate in the assembly and installation of large-scale custom builds, furniture, props, draping, lighting rigs, and structural elements to specification.
  • Scheduling & Workflow Management: Manage on-site timelines, coordinate parallel workstreams, and adjust task allocation in real time to maintain delivery schedule.
  • Quality Control: Conduct on-site QC checks at each installation stage to ensure builds match approved drawings, finish standards, and client expectations.
  • Health & Safety Leadership: Enforce site safety protocols, conduct toolbox talks, manage permit-to-work processes, and ensure PPE compliance across the full crew.
  • Client & Stakeholder Interface: Act as the primary on-site contact for clients, venue managers, and project coordinators during installation; escalate issues proactively.
  • Derig & Asset Recovery: Lead the safe and efficient derig of all installations post-event; ensure all company assets are accounted for, undamaged, and loaded for return.
  • Snag Management: Identify, document, and resolve installation snags in real time; escalate structural or design issues to the project manager immediately.
  • Logistics Coordination: Manage vehicle loading/unloading sequences, site access scheduling, and coordination with logistics teams for on-time material delivery.

qualifications.text:

  • Minimum 7+ years of experience in event installation, fit-out, exhibition, or live events production — with at least 2 years in a supervisory role.
  • Proven ability to lead and motivate a multi-trade crew in a high-pressure, deadline-driven site environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of installation techniques for wood, metal, fabric, and soft furnishing elements.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical installation drawings, CAD plans, and build specifications.
  • Working at Height certification (IPAF/PASMA or equivalent) — mandatory.
  • Manual Handling and First Aid certification preferred.
  • Strong spatial awareness and problem-solving capability to resolve on-site conflicts between design intent and site conditions.
  • Excellent communication skills in English; Arabic language skills advantageous.
  • Valid driving licence with experience operating vans or trucks for site logistics

The Painting Technician is a skilled craftsperson responsible for all surface finishing work across custom event fabrication projects. Operating in a fast-paced workshop environment, this role demands expertise in applying various paint types, finishes, and surface treatments to diverse materials including wood, metal, foam, and fabric. Role Overview
The Styrofoam Sculpting & Fabrication Technician is a specialist craftsperson responsible for designing, cutting, and sculpting expanded polystyrene (EPS/Styrofoam) into large-scale props, decorative elements, signage, and structural components for custom event builds. This role demands both artistic ability and technical precision to transform raw foam blocks into finished pieces that meet exacting design specifications.

jobDescription.text:
The Installation Engineer in the event fabrication workshop is responsible for the hands-on assembly, setup, and dismantlement of custom-built scenic elements, exhibition stands, displays, and event structures at client venues and event sites. Working under the Installation Manager, this role ensures that all fabricated components are installed accurately, safely, and in line with approved design specifications. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled and physically capable individual with direct experience in event installation or fit-out, who can work efficiently under site conditions and tight event timelines.

Key Responsibilities
1. On-Site Installation & Dismantlement
• Assembly & Setup: Execute the physical installation of scenic elements, structures, branding, and custom props in accordance with design drawings and Installation Manager's direction.
• Dismantlement: Carry out safe and efficient breakdown of all installed items post-event, ensuring materials are correctly packed and returned.
• Drawing Compliance: Interpret and work from technical drawings, assembly guides, and site layouts to ensure accurate installation.
• On-Site Problem-Solving: Identify and resolve minor technical issues during installation, escalating complex problems to the Installation Manager.

2. Quality & Finishing
• Quality Checks: Inspect installed elements against approved drawings and samples, ensuring structural integrity and finish quality.
• Snag Resolution: Address punch-list items and snags identified during or after installation promptly.
• Site Cleanliness: Maintain a clean, organized work area throughout the installation and dismantlement process.

3. Safety & Compliance
• HSE Compliance: Follow all site-specific and company health and safety protocols; use correct PPE at all times.
• Toolbox Talks: Actively participate in pre-installation safety briefings and toolbox talks.
• Hazard Reporting: Identify and immediately report any unsafe site conditions, near-misses, or equipment issues to the Installation Manager.

4. Tools, Equipment & Logistics
• Equipment Operation: Operate hand tools, power tools, and rigging equipment correctly; operate elevated work platforms (MEWPs) where certified.
• Asset Care: Maintain and account for all tools, equipment, and installation hardware assigned to the site.
• Loading & Transport Support: Assist with loading, unloading, and transporting fabricated elements between the workshop and site.

5. Coordination & Communication
• Team Collaboration: Work closely with fellow engineers, subcontractors, and venue staff under the direction of the Installation Manager.
• Progress Reporting: Provide timely updates to the Installation Manager on task completion, issues, and material requirements

The Quality Manager in the event fabrication workshop will ensure that custom-built, event structures meet client specifications, safety standards, and structural integrity requirements before leaving the workshop and thereafter at the site. This role bridges the gap between creative design, project management, and structural safety.
The Quality Manager will establish, implement, and maintain rigorous quality assurance control procedures for all fabrication, from raw materials to final, installed products. The role involves inspecting bespoke designs, ensuring structural safety, and fostering a "correct at source" culture to reduce rework, meet tight installation deadlines, and maximize client satisfaction.

• Quality System Management: Develop, document, and enforce a quality management system with standard operating procedures (SOPs) for carpentry, metal fabrication, printing, foam, and painting, and assembly at workshop and site.

• Final Inspection & Release: Inspect completed, bespoke event structures for cosmetic, structural, and functional compliance before shipping.
• Supplier & Material Quality: Inspect incoming raw materials to ensure they meet specifications.
• Corrective Action & Rework: Lead investigations into non-conforming items, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
• Health & Safety Compliance: Work with the production team to ensure all fabrications adhere to health and safety regulations, including electrical safety for scenic elements.
• Documentation: Maintain accurate records for client certifications, material traceability, and safety audits.
• Project Liaison: Coordinate with project managers and clients to resolve quality issues and manage expectations.

jobDescription.title: وصف الوظيفة
jobDescription.text:
إعلان وظيفي: مدير مبيعات

الموقع: الرياض

نوع الدوام: كامل

 

هل تمتلك الرؤية لتحويل مشهد الضيافة التقليدي إلى تجربة رقمية رائدة؟

في عنبر نحن لا نوفر مجرد مساحات للسكن؛ نحن نعيد صياغة مستقبل الإقامات القصيرة والممتدة من خلال الدمج بين التقنية المتطورة ورفاهية التصميم والضيافة السعودية، نحن نبحث عن مدير مبيعات طموح، يتمتع بعقلية استراتيجية وشغف حقيقي لقطاع الضيافة للمساهمة في رحلة نمونا وتوسيع قاعدة عملائنا.

 

ما هو دورك:

بصفتك مديراً للمبيعات، ستكون المسؤول عن بناء الشراكات الاستراتيجية ورفع كفاءة الإيرادات. ستعمل في منطقة تتقاطع فيها العقارات، التكنولوجيا، والضيافة، لضمان وصول علامتنا التجارية إلى الفئات المستهدفة من طالبي السكن والشركات والمسافرين.

 

المسؤوليات الرئيسية:

- قيادة استراتيجية المبيعات: تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المبيعات التي توازن بين معدلات الإشغال(Occupancy) ومتوسط السعر اليومي(ADR).

- إدارة القنوات الرقمية: العمل الوثيق مع فريق إدارة الإيرادات لتحسين ظهورنا على المنصات العالمية (OTAs).

- بناء الشراكات المؤسسية (B2B): تحديد واستقطاب حسابات الشركات الكبرى ووكالات إدارة السفر

- تحليل البيانات: استخدام لغة الأرقام لقياس الأداء، وتقديم تقارير استراتيجية تدعم اتخاذ القرار.

 

لماذا تنضم إلينا:

ستكون جزءاً من بيئة عمل استثنائية، سريعة النمو، تعتمد على الابتكار بعيداً عن البيروقراطية التقليدية. نحن نمنحك المساحة لترك بصمتك والمساهمة معنا في إعادة تعريف مفهوم الضيافة.

 

إذا كنت ترى في نفسك الكفاءة والشغف، ننتظر قراءة سيرتك الذاتية

qualifications.text:

- خبرة مثبتة في مبيعات الفنادق مايقل عن 5 سنوات

- شبكة علاقات قوية في قطاع سفر الأعمال.

- إلمام عميق بأنظمة PMS والمنصات العالمية والتوجهات الرقمية الحديثة

- مهارات تفاوض استثنائية وقدرة على بناء علاقات طويلة الأمد.

companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text:
Role Summary

We are seeking a highly dedicated and professional Executive Personal Assistant to provide comprehensive support to a high-profile principal based in Jeddah. This is a demanding and rewarding hybrid role that blends executive-level administrative duties with personal lifestyle management. The successful candidate will act as the principal's right hand, ensuring seamless execution of both business and personal affairs with the utmost discretion and confidentiality. 

This position requires a proactive, resourceful, and adaptable individual who can anticipate needs and operate effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. You will be entrusted with managing complex schedules, coordinating international travel, and serving as a key liaison for all internal and external stakeholders.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Key Responsibilities

Executive & Administrative Support

•Manage and maintain the principal's complex and ever-changing calendar, scheduling appointments, meetings, and reminders to optimize time and efficiency.

•Screen, prioritize, and manage all incoming communications, including emails and calls, responding or redirecting as appropriate with a professional and courteous demeanor.

•Draft, proofread, and format a wide range of documents, including correspondence, reports, and presentations, ensuring accuracy and clarity.

•Prepare and organize materials and briefing notes for meetings, ensuring the principal is fully prepared for all engagements.

Personal & Lifestyle Management

•Act as a trusted gatekeeper and liaison, managing personal appointments and coordinating with household staff to ensure the smooth running of the principal's private life.

•Handle personal errands and special requests with efficiency and discretion.

•Maintain a high level of confidentiality regarding all personal, financial, and family matters.

Travel & Logistics Coordination

•Arrange and manage all aspects of domestic and international travel, including flights, accommodations, visas, and detailed itineraries.

•Provide on-the-ground support during travel, ensuring all arrangements are seamless and any issues are resolved proactively.

•Be prepared to travel with the principal as required, often at short notice.

Communication & Stakeholder Liaison

•Serve as the primary point of contact between the principal and internal/external stakeholders, including business partners, clients, and family members.

•Build and maintain strong relationships with key contacts, representing the principal professionally and positively.

•Handle sensitive information with the highest level of integrity and confidentiality.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
Candidate Profile

•Proven experience as a Personal Assistant, Executive Assistant, or in a similar support role. Experience supporting UHNW individuals or C-level executives is highly advantageous.

•Exceptional organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks simultaneously under pressure.

•Impeccable communication and interpersonal skills, with fluency in both Arabic and English (written and verbal).

•A high degree of emotional intelligence and professional judgment, with the ability to navigate complex social and professional situations.

•Unwavering discretion, integrity, and a deep understanding of the importance of confidentiality.

•Tech literacy, with a high level of proficiency in the MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and other modern productivity tools.

•A proactive and resourceful problem-solver, with a “can-do” attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile.

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
What We Offer

•A competitive salary package, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

•The opportunity to work in a challenging and dynamic role, supporting a prominent individual.

•A position of trust and responsibility, with the potential for growth and development.

companyDescription.text:
We don’t just talk, we do. Lead the change with us.

At the Tony Blair Institute for Global Change, we work with political leaders around the world to drive change. We help governments turn bold ideas into reality so they can deliver for their people. We do it by advising on strategy, policy and delivery, unlocking the power of technology across all three. And by sharing what we learn on the ground, so everyone can benefit. We do it to build more open, inclusive and prosperous countries for people everywhere.


We are a global team of over 800 changemakers, operating in more than 40 countries, across five continents. We are political strategists, policy experts, delivery practitioners, technology specialists and more. We speak more than 45 languages. We are working on over 100 projects, tackling some of the world’s biggest challenges. We’re all here at TBI to make a difference.


In a world of ever more complex challenges, we believe diversity of background and perspective is a strength. We pride ourselves on a culture that values and nurtures difference. We are dedicated to unlocking potential, not only for the countries we work in but also for each of our team members. No matter where you’re from or who you are, if you’re passionate about the transformative power of progressive politics, we invite you to build a better future with us.

jobDescription.title: وصف الوظيفة
jobDescription.text:
Role Summary

The Tony Blair Institute for Global Change (TBI) advises reforming political leaders and governments on strategy, policy and delivery, with technology as an enabler across all three functions. In so doing we make a significant and positive impact for citizens around the world.

The Associates will support our growing project portfolio (both in-country or support from our Riyadh hub), business development activities and horizontal offerings of expertise to our clients.

These are exciting roles requiring exceptional candidates with relevant experience and competencies.

 

We will only consider applicants currently residing in Saudi Arabia, to be based in Riyadh for this         role

 

 

 

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Support projects in-country and/or regional client or development opportunities as TBI advises political leaders on strategy, policy and delivery with technology as the enabler across all three dimensions
  • Develop research, analysis, written insights and other deliverables for clients and senior leadership within TBI
  • Engage with client counterparts to understand client requirements, articulate ideas and

participate in presentations of deliverables

  • Innovate and develop tools that enable efficient management and delivery of programmes (including project dashboards, frameworks and trackers)
  • Support delivery of high levels of project impact, facilitating nimble performance tracking and coordination where required
  • Play a hands-on role in opportunity scoping and relationship building to enable the expansion of TBI to new geographies, including developing presentations for new country clients and senior government officials
  • Support new projects in their inception phase and support implementation as in-country teams are put in place
  • Apply and learn from new and innovative approaches to supporting change and deliver impact

 

 Person Specification

      Fluency in Arabic is a requirement for this role.

We are looking for experienced policy, strategy, and delivery consultants and/or experienced professionals with relevant backgrounds:

 

  • Between 3-5 years’ experience as a political staffer, public servant, or in consulting, economics, finance, multilateral institutions, high impact civil society organisations, and many other previous roles are all considered relevant at TBI. Technology experience is not required but is an asset.
  • Previous experience in strategy consulting and/or management consulting is advantageous
  • A work ethos focused on team success with genuine motivation for colleagues’

performance, growth and well-being

jobDescription.text:
The Business Analyst Venture Building role is a strategic catalyst for turning market signals into validated growth opportunities. You will work closely with product, design, and engineering teams to identify compelling ventures, shape viable business cases, and steward concepts from idea to learning driven validation. This position blends analytical rigor with entrepreneurial energy to drive outcomes that matter for customers and the business alike.

You will conduct rigorous market analysis to size opportunities, map customer needs, and understand competitive dynamics. You will translate market intelligence into actionable opportunities and craft business cases that articulate the value proposition, revenue model, pricing strategy, channel approach, cost structure, and financial projections including unit economics and ROI. Your insights will inform prioritization and guide the strategic roadmap for new ventures within the organization.

Rapid prototyping and experimentation are at the core of your approach. You will define learning agendas with clear hypotheses, success criteria, and test plans, and you will partner with design and engineering to rapid prototype MVPs, pilots, or low fidelity experiments that produce measurable data. You will evaluate results, iterate quickly, and decide on next steps in collaboration with stakeholders, ensuring that every venture concept moves through a disciplined validation cycle while maintaining speed and momentum.

Cross functional collaboration is essential. You will facilitate alignment across product management, design, engineering, data, and operations, translating market signals into product concepts and helping translate insights into concrete roadmaps. You will create compelling, decision ready materials for leadership and stakeholders, contribute to go to market planning, and ensure agreed delivery milestones across disciplines. Your influence will help teams work together efficiently toward a shared venture objective.

As a contributor to the venture building practice, your responsibilities will include managing the lifecycle of venture concepts from discovery through validation, maintaining a hypothesis library, and tracking the metrics that define success. You will advocate for customer centric decisions, present findings to executives, and support scalable operating models that can be extended to future ventures.

What you will bring includes a bachelor's degree in business, economics, engineering, or a related field and 4 to 7 years of experience in business analysis, strategy, product analytics, corporate development, or management consulting. You have experience in venture building or new product development and a track record of translating data into compelling business cases. You are proficient with market sizing, scenario planning, and financial modeling and comfortable using tools such as Excel or Sheets, SQL, or data visualization platforms. You communicate clearly and persuasively, can influence without authority, and thrive in fast paced environments with ambiguity. You are a collaborative teammate who enjoys working with product, design, and engineering to turn insights into impact.

We offer a dynamic and inclusive culture that values curiosity, experimentation, and data driven decision making. You will join a high energy cross functional team and have opportunities to grow into product leadership or venture founder tracks, with exposure to multiple markets and business models. We provide competitive compensation, equity options where applicable, comprehensive benefits, flexible work arrangements, and a commitment to professional development through mentoring and ongoing learning.

If you are excited to build and validate new ventures from first principles and to influence product strategy through rigorous analysis and rapid prototyping, we encourage you to apply. Please share your resume and a short note describing a market opportunity you analyzed or a business case you developed and the impact it had.

## Responsibilities
• Lead market research efforts to identify target customer segments, competitive dynamics, and total addressable market, delivering actionable insights within two weeks of project kickoff.
• Build business cases and financial models (revenue, costs, cash flows, and ROI) to evaluate venture viability and inform investment and prioritization decisions.
• Support rapid prototyping by translating insights into MVP scope, defining success metrics, and guiding cross-functional teams to iterate quickly.
• Collaborate with cross-functional squads (product, engineering, design, data, marketing, and operations) to align on problem framing, requirements, and milestones, ensuring synchronized delivery.
• Track performance metrics across ventures by establishing dashboards, defining KPIs, and providing regular performance updates to leadership and squads.
• Conduct risk analysis and scenario planning to identify critical assumptions, quantify potential impacts, and develop mitigation strategies.
• Evaluate strategic partnerships and business development opportunities by performing due diligence, modeling value creation, and outlining partnership terms and risks.
• Translate strategic hypotheses into testable experiments, oversee experiment design, and measure outcomes to inform prioritization and roadmap adjustments.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
DXC Technology is seeking a Senior Manager to lead the delivery of complex, enterprise IT services for our global clients. This role blends strategic program leadership with hands-on client engagement to drive measurable business value through modernization, cloud, security, data, and application services. You will influence outcomes across multiple cross-functional teams and ensure that programs align with client strategies while advancing DXC’s market leadership in enterprise technology services. This position offers visibility at the executive level, the opportunity to shape large-scale transformations, and a path toward broader leadership within the organization.

As a Senior Manager, you will own the end-to-end delivery lifecycle for strategically important programs. You will guide and synchronize efforts across delivery leads, architecture, engineering, operations, solutions, sales, and client success to ensure on-time, on-budget, high-quality outcomes. You will establish governance structures, define program milestones and success metrics, manage risk and issue resolution, and optimize resource allocation and vendor partnerships. You will translate client goals into actionable roadmaps, prioritize competing demands, and drive continuous improvement through repeatable delivery patterns and robust reporting. Your decisions will balance client value, technical feasibility, risk, and DXC capabilities to deliver sustainable outcomes for large enterprise environments.

This role is highly client-facing and outcomes-driven. You will build trusted advisor relationships with senior client stakeholders, lead discovery sessions, and shape business cases, roadmaps, and transformation blueprints. You will present program status, value realization, and risk posture to C-suite and executive sponsors. You will lead change management activities, align business and IT priorities, and cultivate durable partnerships that extend beyond a single engagement. Your ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling business language will be essential to securing buy-in and accelerating value realization.

Key qualifications include a bachelor's degree in a relevant field, with a preference for advanced degrees. You should bring 8 or more years of experience in enterprise IT services, including 3 or more years in a leadership role overseeing cross-functional, matrixed teams. Demonstrated success delivering multi-faceted programs, ideally involving cloud adoption, digital transformation, data and analytics, cybersecurity, or application modernization, is essential. Strong program and project management capabilities are required, including experience with PMO governance, risk management, and business outcome realization. You should be comfortable with senior client interaction, have excellent communication and negotiation skills, and possess a track record of driving value for large, complex environments. Certifications such as PMP, PgMP, ITIL, or relevant cloud certifications are a plus. A global perspective, comfort with virtual and distributed teams, and willingness to travel as needed are important. You should be able to operate with a bias toward action, influence without direct authority, and demonstrate resilience in dynamic, client-focused environments.

Decision-making responsibilities include prioritizing program portfolios and scope, approving changes within defined thresholds, balancing competing client and DXC priorities, approving major milestones and offshore/onshore staffing decisions, and determining escalation paths for high-risk issues. You will authorize vendor and partner engagement strategies within governance limits and contribute to shaping pricing, commercial terms, and engagement models in collaboration with sales and delivery leadership. You will also influence solution design and delivery approaches to maximize business impact while maintaining compliance with DXC standards and client requirements.

DXC offers substantial growth opportunities for high-performing leaders. In this role, you will have a clear path to senior leadership tracks, including Director and above, with opportunities to lead large-scale, strategic programs across multiple industries and geographies. You will gain exposure to diverse clients and technologies, enable ongoing professional development through formal training, certifications, and mentorship, and participate in leadership development programs. You will work in a culture that values collaboration, diverse perspectives, and continuous learning, with support for flexible work arrangements and work-life integration.

DXC Technology fosters an inclusive, collaborative environment where every voice matters. We are committed to building a diverse and equitable workplace that reflects the communities we serve. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences and welcome differing viewpoints to strengthen our teams and our client solutions. We strive to create an environment where everyone can contribute fully, grow professionally, and feel respected and valued.

If you are a results-driven leader who thrives in complex enterprise environments, enjoys building strong client partnerships, and has a track record of delivering value through strategic IT services, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume and a cover letter that highlights how your experience aligns with this role and your leadership approach. DXC Technology is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace for all employees.

## Responsibilities
• Lead and coordinate multiple IT services teams across applications, infrastructure, and support to ensure aligned delivery against strategic objectives and defined SLAs.
• Manage and deliver complex programs and multi-project portfolios from initiation through closure, ensuring on-time, within-budget delivery and measurable business outcomes through standardized governance and stage gates.
• Oversee budget planning, forecasting, and financial controls for IT services, optimize spend, track variances, and provide ROI analysis to executive leadership.
• Establish and maintain strong stakeholder relationships with executive sponsors, business units, and vendors; provide transparent status updates, manage expectations, and secure alignment on priorities.
• Identify, assess, and mitigate project and operational risks; develop and implement risk response plans, control activities, and contingency measures, with regular risk dashboards.
• Mentor and develop team leaders and engineers across multiple teams; establish coaching, career development plans, and succession planning to build capability and retention.
• Lead continuous improvement across service delivery by introducing ITIL-aligned processes, optimizing incident, change, problem management, and service continuity; implement metrics to drive performance.
• Drive vendor and contract management for third-party service providers; negotiate terms, monitor performance against service levels, and manage escalations.
• Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and regulatory standards across IT services; implement control frameworks and conduct regular audits.

المسؤوليات والمهام الرئيسية

  • تطوير الاستراتيجيات: تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجية نمو شاملة وفعالة تركز على زيادة الإيرادات ورضا العملاء، والتوسع في أسواق جديدة.
  • توليد الفرص (Lead Generation): تحديد العملاء المحتملين (Leads) والأسواق المستهدفة الجديدة من خلال البحث وتحليل السوق.
  • بناء العلاقات: بناء وإدارة علاقات طويلة الأمد وقوية مع العملاء الجدد والحاليين والشركاء الاستراتيجيين والمؤثرين في القطاع.
  • المبيعات والتفاوض: ترتيب اجتماعات عمل مع العملاء، عرض منتجات/خدمات الشركة، والتفاوض على العقود والأسعار وإبرام الصفقات لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المالية.
  • تحليل السوق: إجراء أبحاث معمقة للسوق، ومراقبة اتجاهات الصناعة وتحركات المنافسين، وتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف لدينا لاقتناص الفرص.
  • إعداد التقارير: تتبع وتحليل أرقام المبيعات والإيرادات وأداء الأعمال، وتقديم تقارير وتوقعات دقيقة للإدارة العليا.
  • التعاون الداخلي: العمل بتناغم مع فرق المبيعات والتسويق والعمليات لضمان تقديم حلول متكاملة تلبي احتياجات العملاء.
  • تحسين الأداء: اقتراح طرق مبتكرة لتطوير وتحسين المنتجات أو الخدمات الحالية لزيادة قيمتها في السوق.

companyDescription.title: معلومات عن الشركة
companyDescription.text:
We don’t just talk, we do. Lead the change with us.

At the Tony Blair Institute for Global Change, we work with political leaders around the world to drive change. We help governments turn bold ideas into reality so they can deliver for their people. We do it by advising on strategy, policy and delivery, unlocking the power of technology across all three. And by sharing what we learn on the ground, so everyone can benefit. We do it to build more open, inclusive and prosperous countries for people everywhere.


We are a global team of over 800 changemakers, operating in more than 40 countries, across five continents. We are political strategists, policy experts, delivery practitioners, technology specialists and more. We speak more than 45 languages. We are working on over 100 projects, tackling some of the world’s biggest challenges. We’re all here at TBI to make a difference.


In a world of ever more complex challenges, we believe diversity of background and perspective is a strength. We pride ourselves on a culture that values and nurtures difference. We are dedicated to unlocking potential, not only for the countries we work in but also for each of our team members. No matter where you’re from or who you are, if you’re passionate about the transformative power of progressive politics, we invite you to build a better future with us.

jobDescription.title: وصف الوظيفة
jobDescription.text:
The Tony Blair Institute for Global Change (TBI) advises reforming political leaders and governments on strategy, policy and delivery, with technology as an enabler across all three functions. In so doing we make a significant and positive impact for citizens around the world.

 

As an Analyst at TBI in Riyadh, you will conduct quantitative and qualitative research and analysis for teams across the Middle East.

These are exciting roles requiring exceptional candidates with relevant experiences and competencies.

 

We will only consider Saudi Nationals, currently residing in Saudi Arabia, to be based in Riyadh for this role

 

Key Responsibilities

 

• Provide research support under the guidance of the Research team in a timely and efficient manner

• Undertake original research involving primary analytical work as well as secondary analysis

of the academic and policy literature

• Review and summarise research findings clearly and concisely

• Participate in the planning and coordination of internal and external events

• Build and utilise a network of external partners in the political and policy spheres Responsibility

• Write policy briefings and research notes for meetings and media appearances for TBI representatives

• Represent the Institute in policy and research settings both on social media and at conferences and events

• Analyse data and contribute to the production of visual analytics and impactful (social) media content Judgement

• Demonstrate an analytical mindset with careful attention to quality and accuracy

• Identify and scope new political or policy opportunities for viability and alignment with Institute goals

• Take ownership and personal initiate to achieve work outputs Ambition

• Research to the highest standard and present your findings in a compelling, clear way

• Be innovative and show initiative in your work

• Read around relevant subject areas to bring a deeper understanding and knowledge

• Be proactive in sharing ideas and thought

 

Person Specification

Fluency in Arabic is a requirement for this role.

     The successful candidate for the role should be able to display the majority of the following:

• A passion for using analysis and creativity to provide research that can help to revitalise the centre ground of politics

• An interest in the big political and policy questions facing governments globally

• Ability to find and synthesise relevant information sources

• Ability to analyse and understand the detail of major policy areas in order to make effective proposals for reform

• Familiarity with using quantitative techniques to analyse data, such as household surveys, and using it to build an evidence base

• Ability to write with clarity and impact

• Proven high standard of verbal communication

• Strong understanding of other marketing and media disciplines such as social media, print and broadcast

• Work collaboratively with colleagues and perform other duties as reasonably required to achieve the goals of your team and the Institute

• Previous experience in a think tank, government, academic or consulting environment desired

companyDescription.text:
SaudiBridge is a 360° business solutions platform built to connect Saudi Arabia with the world

and the world with Saudi Arabia. Through strategic market entry support, global delegations,

and deep ecosystem engagement, SaudiBridge positions the Kingdom as a global destination

for innovation, investment, and entrepreneurship.

We enable international companies to enter, grow, and scale within Saudi Arabia, while also

unlocking outbound opportunities for Saudi entrepreneurs, startups, and innovators to expand

globally. SaudiBridge goes beyond traditional expansion services by acting as a trusted bridge

between markets, ecosystems, and opportunities.

Our mission is to make Saudi Arabia the most accessible, connected, and attractive hub for

global business.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
We are seeking a highly creative and detail driven Creative Marketing and Communications

Manager to lead SaudiBridge’s brand identity, storytelling, content, and marketing presence

across digital and physical channels. This role combines creative direction, content

development, visual design oversight, experiential and event communications, and campaign

execution.

The ideal candidate is a creative storyteller who understands ecosystem positioning, can

translate strategy into compelling visuals and messaging, and can design marketing outputs that

reflect the premium and global nature of SaudiBridge.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and manage SaudiBridge’s brand positioning, tone of voice, and visual identity across all platforms and materials.
  • Lead the planning and execution of marketing campaigns for programs, delegations, partnerships, and corporate initiatives.
  • Create and oversee high quality content including presentations, decks, reports, social media content, event materials, and marketing collateral.
  • Write clear and compelling copy for proposals, announcements, partnerships, campaigns, and corporate communications.
  • Support event and delegation communications including branding, on site visuals, agendas, backdrops, and overall experience design.

  • Collaborate with business development and operations teams to translate services and initiatives into strong narratives and marketing assets.

  • Maintain a structured content calendar and ensure timely development and delivery of marketing outputs

East40 is looking for Operations & Data Associate

Department: Central Org / Shared Resources Team

About us

We are a private, institutional family office committed to preserving and compounding capital over a multi-generational horizon. Our work encompasses constructing a multi-asset global investment portfolio, fostering cross-border partnerships, and contributing to the family’s legacy, philanthropic goals, and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's development.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
The Operations & Data Associate will serve as an operational and data backbone for East40’s Shared Resources Team, supporting both portfolio companies and strategic partnerships. The role will have a primary focus on a strategic partnership with a leading US venture capital firm, while also supporting stakeholders across the Shared Resources team and central organization. Responsibilities include managing data systems, developing dashboards and insights, optimizing workflows, and driving process excellence across operating entities and partnerships.

The successful candidate will maintain data integrity across operational tracking systems, manage workflows and documentation, generate analysis and reporting, and coordinate day-to-day operations for the Shared Services Team. This is a hands-on role suited to a technology-savvy professional with strong attention to detail and the ability to translate complex activities into structured data, repeatable processes, and actionable insights.

Operations, Data Analytics, and Systems

  • Maintain and administer core data systems for the Shared Resources Team, including CRM (HubSpot), Notion databases, deal-tracking tools, and talent pipelines.
  • Ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity of data across all tracking systems (portfolio companies, contacts, deals, candidates, meeting notes, and action items).
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports, market intelligence views, relationship maps, and operational KPIs.
  • Produce regular reporting on partnership performance, deal flow, talent placements, and key strategic milestones.

Workflow & Process Optimization

  • Design and implement workflows for shared services operations (e.g., deal intake, portfolio company onboarding, talent sourcing, event and visit management, follow-up tracking).
  • Support emerging initiatives such as AI agent design/monitoring and process automation across the organization.
  • Coordinate between the strategic partner and East40’s Shared Services Team (operations, administration) to ensure smooth, timely execution.
  • Implement solutions and tracking mechanisms for partnership activities, including portfolio company meetings, regional visits, and strategic events.
  • Track and manage action items, deliverables, and deadlines across partnership workstreams.

Systems Administration & Tools Management

  • Act as a power user for core tools: Notion, HubSpot CRM, Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management platforms.
  • Implement lightweight automations to reduce manual work and enhance data flows between systems.
  • Evaluate and recommend new tools or enhancements to improve operational and partnership efficiency.
  • Support Shared Services–wide initiatives in data management, process standardization, and  operational best practices.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of shared templates, databases, and operational playbooks.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• 5–7 years of experience in operations, business operations, PMO, data management, or a related field. This experience range is important for us so over and under experienced candidates will not be shortlisted. 
  • Saudi candidates will be given preference. 
  • Experience in family offices, investment firms, professional services, or high-growth environments is preferred.
  • Exposure to multi-entity structures, shared services models, or complex stakeholder environments is advantageous.

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
• Organizational excellence: Ability to manage multiple workstreams and deadlines with precision and attention to detail across various entities and stakeholders.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills: Ability to interpret data, identify patterns, and propose practical, scalable solutions.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic proficiency is a plus.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable operating in a dynamic environment with shifting priorities and urgent demands.
  • Stakeholder management: Ability to collaborate effectively with senior leaders, external partners, and cross-functional teams.

Personal attributes

  • Proactive and anticipatory mindset, with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Resourceful and solution-oriented, able to work independently while knowing when to seek input.
  • Professional maturity, discretion, and sound judgment in handling sensitive information.
  • Collaborative spirit and low-ego attitude, with a willingness to “roll up sleeves” on both strategic and operational tasks.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and staying current on best practices in operations, data, and tools.
  • Alignment with our values: Meritocracy, Ethics, Responsibility, Collaboration, and Impact.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Position Summary

The IT technician provides technical support for all school hardware, software, networks, and user devices. The role ensures smooth daily operations, quick resolution of IT issues, and maintains a high standard of service to staff, students, and administrative teams.

The technician works under the IT Supervisor/Manager and collaborates with other IT team members to support the school’s digital infrastructure and ensure minimal downtime.

Key Responsibilities

1. User Support & Helpdesk

  • Respond to IT tickets, emails, and walk-ins from staff and students.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to:
  1. Laptops, Chromebooks, desktops
  2. Printers, scanners, copiers
  3. Projectors, interactive boards
  4. Classroom technology
  5. Wi-Fi & network connectivity
  • Assist with password resets (Google Workspace / Microsoft / internal systems).
  • Provide basic user training for staff and students when needed.

2. Device Management

  • Configure, install, and maintain: Windows laptops and Chromebooks (enrollment, updates, licensing)
  • Perform imaging or setup for new devices.
  • Monitor device health, updates, and performance.
  • Maintain accurate asset records in the ITAM system/IT logs.

3. Network & Infrastructure Support

  • Basic troubleshooting of switches, firewall and APs.
  • Identify cable faults, replace damaged patch cables, and update labels.
  • Support a secure and reliable network for staff and students.
  • Report major outages to the IT Manager.

4. Systems & Accounts

  • Create and manage user accounts (Google Workspace, School Systems).
  • Assign permissions based on roles.
  • Support email configuration and login issues.
  • Provide support for Google services.
  • Maintain shared drives, groups, and basic security configurations.

 5. Classroom Technology Support

  • Daily check of projectors, sound systems, and interactive panels.
  • Install and support educational software.
  • Troubleshoot display issues, HDMI, adapters, and sound problems.
  • Assist teachers during lessons when support is required.

6. Printers & Peripheral Management

  • Install printer drivers and connect devices to network printers.
  • Troubleshoot printing issues (paper jams, toner, connectivity).
  • Monitor ink/toner levels and assist with replacements.
  • Coordinate with vendors for repairs.

7. Maintenance & Preventive Work

  • Perform routine hardware cleaning and maintenance.
  • Ensure cables are organized, labeled, and documented.
  • Keep IT rooms, storage areas, and equipment racks tidy.


8. Software Support

  • Install approved applications and updates.
  • Remove unauthorized or risky software.
  • Configure browsers, security settings, and productivity tools.
  • Support educational platforms like (Engage, ManageBac, Help Desk systems, etc.

9. Documentation & Reporting

  • Update IT logs, inventory, and maintenance sheets.
  • Document Daily Tasks in the IT Help Desk System
  • Document recurring problems and solutions.
  • Escalate unresolved cases to the IT Supervisor/Manager.
  • Prepare checklists for classroom technology inspections.

10. Event & Operational Support

  • Provide IT assistance for school events (graduations, assemblies, and rehearsals).
  • Set up microphones, speakers, projectors, and other AV tools.
  • Support other departments with meetings/events/training…etc. in IT setups.
  • Provide dedicated on-site technical support during key events to ensure seamless operation during events outside working hours if needed.

jobDescription.title: وصف الوظيفة
jobDescription.text:
إعلان وظيفة: مهندس مدني مشاريع (3-5 سنوات خبرة)

المسمى الوظيفي: مهندس مدني مشاريع

الموقع: الرياض أو نجران، المملكة العربية السعودية

الخبرة المطلوبة: 3 إلى 5 سنوات

نبذة عن الوظيفة:

تبحث شركتنا عن مهندس مدني مشاريع ذي خبرة للانضمام إلى فريق العمل لدينا في مشاريعنا في الرياض أو نجران. يجب أن يمتلك المرشح مهارات قوية في الإشراف الموقعي، إدارة فرق العمل والمقاولين من الباطن، بالإضافة إلى إتقان أعمال التصميم، قراءة المخططات، وإجراءات الشراء والتسعير.

المسؤوليات الرئيسية:

  • الإشراف الموقعي: إدارة وتنفيذ ومراقبة جميع الأنشطة الهندسية والإنشائية في الموقع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات والجداول الزمنية.
  • إدارة فرق العمل: التعامل المباشر مع العمالة والمقاولين من الباطن وتوجيههم وتنسيق أعمالهم لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة.
  • التصميم والمخططات:
    • إتقان قراءة وفهم وتحليل المخططات الهندسية والرسومات التفصيلية.
    • القدرة على المساهمة أو مراجعة أعمال التصميم الهندسية ذات الصلة بالمشروع.
  • المشتريات والتسعير (Procurement and Pricing):
    • المشاركة في عمليات طلب المواد والمعدات وتقدير الكميات.
    • إعداد عروض الأسعار والمساهمة في تحليل تكاليف المشروع.
  • ضمان الجودة والسلامة: الالتزام بتطبيق معايير الجودة والسلامة في جميع مراحل المشروع.
  • إعداد التقارير الدورية عن سير العمل ورفعها إلى الإدارة العليا.

 

    كيفية التقديم:

    يرجى إرسال السيرة الذاتية (CV) محدثة ومرفق بها قائمة بالمشاريع السابقة إلى البريد الإلكتروني: Hr@iaas-sa.com

    ملاحظة: يرجى كتابة "مهندس مدني - الرياض/نجران" في خانة الموضوع.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Kanz is looking for a founding Growth Lead who is not afraid to wear two hats: Strategic Marketer and Business Developer. We need a self-starter who can build our inbound brand engine while simultaneously running aggressive outbound campaigns.

Your mission is to drive qualified meetings for the CEO through two channels: a creative content strategy focusing on our "Schedule qualified interviews in 48 hours, effortlessly" promise, and a data-driven outbound sales engine.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
Core Priorities

1. The Marketing Engine (Inbound & Community)

  • Campaign Strategy: Develop and execute a marketing strategy centered on our core value prop: "Schedule qualified interviews in 48 hours, effortlessly."

  • Content Production: Create compelling assets (graphics, one-pagers, short-form copy) tailored for Hiring Managers and HR professionals. Use of AI is encouraged.

  • Guerrilla Distribution: Identify, join, and actively engage in niche Recruiter and HR WhatsApp groups. You will not just spam, but build authority to drive traffic.


2. The Sales Engine (Outbound & SDR)

  • Prospecting & Data: Manage large datasets of potential leads. You will clean, verify, and segment lists to feed into our email marketing engines.

  • Outbound Execution: Use of automated email tools to qualify leads.

  • The Goal: You are responsible for booking 2-3 qualified meetings per day for the CEO.

  • Pipeline Management: Ensure leads are qualified strictly before reaching the CEO and manage the CRM flow.

 

What We Are Looking For

  • Flexibility: You are just as comfortable designing a social post as you are managing a 5,000-row CSV file.

  • Tech Savvy: Experience with Email Automation, CRM tools, and reporting dashboards.

  • Sales DNA: You don't fear rejection. You are willing to pick up the phone and follow up relentlessly.

  • Creative Eye: You can use tools like Canva or Figma to make our brand look professional.

  • Regional Knowledge: Experience targeting the Saudi market is essential.

 

Why Join Us?

  • You will be the "Engine Room" of the company, directly impacting revenue and brand.

  • High autonomy to test new strategies—from "Dark Social" (WhatsApp) to Cold Email hacks.

  • Significant growth opportunities to grow as the team expands.

companyDescription.title: معلومات عن الشركة
companyDescription.text:
We don’t just talk, we do. Lead the change with us.

At the Tony Blair Institute for Global Change, we work with political leaders around the world to drive change. We help governments turn bold ideas into reality so they can deliver for their people. We do it by advising on strategy, policy and delivery, unlocking the power of technology across all three. And by sharing what we learn on the ground, so everyone can benefit. We do it to build more open, inclusive and prosperous countries for people everywhere.


We are a global team of over 800 changemakers, operating in more than 40 countries, across five continents. We are political strategists, policy experts, delivery practitioners, technology specialists and more. We speak more than 45 languages. We are working on over 100 projects, tackling some of the world’s biggest challenges. We’re all here at TBI to make a difference.


In a world of ever more complex challenges, we believe diversity of background and perspective is a strength. We pride ourselves on a culture that values and nurtures difference. We are dedicated to unlocking potential, not only for the countries we work in but also for each of our team members. No matter where you’re from or who you are, if you’re passionate about the transformative power of progressive politics, we invite you to build a better future with us.

We will only consider Saudi Nationals for this role

  • Develop research, analysis, written insights and other deliverables for clients and senior leadership within TBI

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
The HCIS Consultant is responsible for managing and executing all activities related to compliance with the High Commission for Industrial Security (HCIS) directives across all project stages. This includes preparing and submitting Stage 1 (Risk Assessment) and Stage 2 (Design) documentation, reviewing Stage 3 (Construction) and Stage 4 (Final Inspection) deliverables, and coordinating directly with clients, contractors, and HCIS representatives to achieve full approval.

Key Responsibilities:

Stage 1 – Security Risk Assessment (SRA)

  • Conduct site visits, threat analysis, and risk assessments per HCIS directives.
  • Identify facility classification and determine the appropriate security level (A, B, C).
  • Prepare the Stage 1 SRA Report and supporting documents for HCIS submission.
  • Coordinate with clients and HCIS reviewers to address comments and obtain approval.

Stage 2 – Security Design (Concept & Detailed)

  • Develop and prepare Stage 2 documentation, including security concept layouts, block diagrams, detailed system designs, BOQs, and compliance matrices.
  • Ensure designs comply with HCIS standards, client security requirements, and site conditions.
  • Participate in technical and design review meetings until HCIS approval is achieved.

Stage 3 – Construction & Implementation Review

  • Review contractors’ shop drawings, material submittals, and method statements for HCIS compliance.
  • Conduct field visits and technical audits to ensure installations align with approved Stage 2 designs.
  • Provide compliance reports and guidance to resolve non-conformities.
  • Participate in coordination meetings with EPC contractors, end users, and HCIS inspectors.

Stage 4 – Final Inspection & Handover

  • Attend pre-final and final inspections with HCIS representatives.
  • Review as-built drawings, test results, and commissioning reports.
  • Prepare the final compliance documentation package and support clients in obtaining HCIS final approval.
  • Document lessons learned and improvement recommendations for future projects.

General Duties

  • Maintain an updated archive of all HCIS submissions, revisions, and approvals.
  • Monitor updates to HCIS directives, circulars, and amendments and ensure internal compliance.
  • Provide internal training and technical support for engineering teams.
  • Liaise with clients, consultants, and authorities to resolve compliance or technical issues.
  • Review new projects, proposals, and tenders to identify HCIS requirements and prepare compliance documentation.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Bachelor’s degree in Security, Electrical, or Systems Engineering (or a related field).
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in physical security systems and HCIS compliance (Stages 1–4).
  • Proven experience with Aramco, SEC, SABIC, or other critical-infrastructure projects.
  • Strong analytical and documentation skills.

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bilingual (Arabic / English) communication skills.
  • HCIS-approved Consultant / Security Professional certification.
  • ASIS CPP / PSP certification.
  • PMP or equivalent project management certification (preferred).
  • ISO 27001 awareness / implementer certification (advantage).

Key Competencies:

  • Expert knowledge of HCIS Security Directives (2021 and later).
  • Strong understanding of integrated security system design and implementation.
