jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
The Physical Security Systems Engineer is responsible for the design, configuration, installation, testing, and commissioning of integrated electronic security systems, including CCTV, Access Control Systems (ACS), and Intrusion Detection & Alarm Systems (IDAS). The engineer will ensure all systems are implemented according to project requirements, international standards, and client specifications while providing technical support throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Design & Engineering

  • Develop and review system designs, schematics, and shop drawings for CCTV, ACS, and IDAS.

  • Prepare device layouts, riser diagrams, cable routing, and power/networking plans.

  • Ensure all designs comply with client specifications, HCIS, SEC, or MOI standards, and project scope.

  • Participate in technical submittal preparation and handle design-related queries from clients or consultants.

2. Installation & Configuration

  • Supervise or support the installation of cameras, access control devices, panels, and sensors.

  • Configure and integrate systems using manufacturer software and network tools.

  • Verify proper functionality of all field devices, controllers, and network connectivity.

  • Conduct pre-commissioning and final testing to ensure full system performance.

3. Commissioning & Support

  • Perform system commissioning, programming, and troubleshooting for CCTV, ACS, and IDAS.

  • Conduct system acceptance testing (SAT/FAT) and prepare related reports.

  • Provide technical support and on-site guidance to project and maintenance teams.

  • Support preparation of as-built drawings, configuration backups, and O&M documentation.

4. Coordination & Communication

  • Coordinate with project managers, design engineers, and site supervisors for smooth execution.

  • Communicate with vendors and suppliers to ensure compatibility of components.

  • Support procurement by reviewing technical datasheets, material submittals, and compliance lists.

  • Attend site meetings, client inspections, and technical workshops as required.

qualifications.title: Qualifications

jobDescription.title: وصف الوظيفة
jobDescription.text:
We are seeking a hands-on Business Controller / Senior Analyst to deliver high-impact analysis across our hospital group. This role will serve as the go-to analytics partner for department heads and senior leadership, driving rapid, data-informed decisions at one of the largest hospital groups in the Kingdom.

The ideal candidate will be exceptionally skilled in Excel, capable of building sophisticated, multi-tab models connected through advanced formulas (e.g., VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS), Macros/VBA, and direct integrations with enterprise data tools such as Power BI and centralized analytics data models via Analyze in Excel.

This person will be relied on for business insights, performance tracking, and cross-functional analysis. Most analyses will leverage datasets from our centralized BI foundations (Power BI and data cubes), with deliverables produced in Excel for maximum business relevance. They will also be able to design dynamic dashboards in Excel—auto-refreshable monthly, with interconnected and automatically updated spreadsheets consolidating inputs across multiple functions and data sources.

Key Expectations

  • Build and maintain sophisticated Excel models for forecasting, cost tracking, staffing efficiency, volume analysis, and more—supporting budgeting, forecasting, and weekly performance reviews.

  • Translate complex data into clear insights, visualizations, and executive-level reports for senior leadership.

  • Collaborate across Operations, Strategy, Customer Service, Customer Experience, Finance, Supply Chain, and Clinical teams to drive cross-functional decision-making.

  • Partner with C-level stakeholders to translate business questions into analytical models and actionable recommendations.

  • Identify trends, flag performance risks, and highlight opportunities for efficiency and cost improvement.

  • Spot and address data quality gaps, providing immediate, actionable insights.

 

Key Responsibilities

Analytics & Reporting

  • Act as the central analytical point-of-contact for multiple departments (clinical and non-clinical).

  • Deliver fast, accurate, and business-relevant analysis using advanced Excel features (PivotTables, PowerQuery, advanced formulas, dynamic dashboards).

  • Connect directly to Power BI datasets and company-wide analytics platforms (data cubes) via Analyze in Excel—no coding required.

  • Maintain Excel models for forecasting, cost tracking, staffing efficiency, volume/capacity analysis, and planning.

  • Support weekly performance reviews and monthly budgeting/forecasting cycles.

  • Spot trends, surface issues, and suggest efficiency/cost improvements.

  • Produce executive-ready reports and presentations from complex models.

 

Business Partnering

  • Serve as the analytical partner for departments and business units, delivering both ad hoc and recurring analysis.

  • Support planning, budgeting, and performance management across clinical and administrative units.

  • Collaborate across Strategy, Operations, Finance, Supply Chain, and Clinical functions to enable data-driven decisions.

  • Work closely with C-level executives, turning business questions into actionable insights.

Performance Optimization

  • Proactively identify trends, outliers, and inefficiencies, and recommend improvements.

  • Partner with BI and IT teams to ensure robust data availability and usability.

  • Promote a data-driven culture, empowering teams with insights and training on business controlling.

    • Complex PivotTables, dynamic dashboards, multi-tab models with advanced formulas (VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, IF).

    • Linking models to external data sources (Power BI).

The Engineering Director will lead SiFi's technical architecture and engineering excellence across all development disciplines, driving the delivery of secure, scalable, and innovative financial technology solutions. This role is responsible for building and scaling high-performing engineering teams in backend, frontend, mobile, and quality assurance, while ensuring all engineering practices meet the stringent requirements of financial services regulations and SiFi's commitment to product excellence.

The Engineering Director will partner closely with the Infrastructure Manager to create a unified technology organization that delivers reliable, secure, and cost-effective solutions. They must establish robust engineering processes, implement comprehensive quality assurance frameworks, and ensure all development teams can deliver features that meet SAMA regulatory standards and customer expectations.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Key Responsibilities

  • Lead technical architecture strategy and engineering standards across backend, frontend, mobile, and QA disciplines.

  • Build, develop, and scale high-performing engineering teams with clear career progression paths and performance expectations.

  • Establish and enforce engineering best practices including secure coding standards, testing frameworks, and deployment processes that meet financial services requirements.

  • Partner with Product teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions that drive customer value and business growth.

  • Collaborate with the Infrastructure Manager to ensure seamless integration between development and operations, implementing effective DevOps and SRE practices.

  • Ensure all engineering deliverables comply with SAMA regulations and financial services security standards through secure development lifecycle practices.

  • Drive technical innovation while maintaining focus on system reliability, performance, and maintainability of financial platforms.

  • Oversee comprehensive QA strategies including automated testing, performance testing, and security testing to ensure product quality.

  • Manage technology vendor relationships, development tools, and engineering infrastructure costs to optimize ROI and operational efficiency.

  • Implement engineering metrics and KPIs to drive data-driven decision making and continuous improvement across all development teams.

  • Serve as technical escalation point for complex engineering challenges and ensure timely resolution of production issues.

  • Uphold and actively champion SiFi's values:

    • Customer Centricity (building solutions that truly serve customer needs and reduce friction).

    • Product-First Mindset (engineering excellence that enables fewer features done right, with laser focus on business impact).

    • Data-Driven Execution (implementing observability and metrics to guide technical decisions and performance optimization).

    • Continuous Innovation (leveraging automation and modern development practices to accelerate delivery).

    • Open Communication & Collaboration (fostering transparent cross-functional teamwork between engineering, product, and operations).

    • High Pace, High Standards (delivering features rapidly while maintaining the precision and reliability required in fintech operations).

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
Qualifications & Skills

  • 12+ years of engineering experience with at least 5 years in senior leadership roles building and scaling engineering teams (15+ engineers).

companyDescription.text:
About Trivandi

Trivandi was formed in 2013 by the leadership team that planned, delivered and operated the 120+ venues of the London 2012 Games.

Their mission was to share their knowledge and learnings from London 2012 to help the industry to keep growing, evolving and improving, whilst protecting our beautiful planet.

Since then, Trivandi itself has grown and evolved by building and nurturing a world-class global team of the industry's best talent in multiple areas of expertise.

We capture our knowledge and learnings from each project and apply them to next to drive continual improvement and leave a lasting legacy of knowledge and know how

About Trivandi Academy  

Trivandi Academy, part of the Trivandi family, is dedicated to building a stronger, more sustainable global major events sector through world-class professional development, research, and knowledge sharing. 

Launched in May 2024, the Academy was created to address pressing challenges in the industry: better support for professionals at every career stage, globally recognised qualifications and standards, improved wellbeing, and more effective knowledge transfer between major events. 

Our mission is to lead in learning and development by delivering expert-led, certified training, tailored programs, leadership development, mentoring, and industry insights. We design content for real-world application, with a flexible, learner-first approach grounded in inclusiveness, integrity, and excellence.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
About the Role 

We are looking for an exceptional leader to shape the future of one of the most groundbreaking academies in sport, events and live entertainment. 

 

As Director of Trivandi Academy, you will lead a pioneering global initiative, developing strategy, driving business development, and being the face of the Trivandi Acaddemy in a number of markets. You will manage client relationships, providing learning innovation and capability building services across major events. Products and services provided by you and your team will include strategy, in-person and digital product development, executive coaching, workforce and volunteer training, company culture and values, and advising on flagship training venues in KSA.  

 

Trivandi Academy delivers products and services to external clients, with a focus on capability-building, cultural transformation, and knowledge transfer across organisations, mega-events, and much, much more - ensuring a lasting human legacy that transforms futures across the industry. 

As a sector leader, you will play a key role in setting and executing strategy, growing the business, and delivering exceptional client outcomes for us internationally and, with a particular focus on KSA.  You will lead the strategy of delivering outstanding work in a uniquely creative, people-centred way to our clients. 

To come on this journey with us, you will have strong leadership skills, be a genuine team-player, have a great sense of humour, and relish a challenge. You will have relationships across the business and will understand the value of strong personal relationships and a collaborative mindset.  

Key Competencies – Sector Leader 

  • Vision 
  • Goal setting and delivery  
  • Sector Insight  
  • Operational excellence  
  • Relationship management 
  • Business Development
  • Innovation  
  • Leadership 
  • Cross-functional working 

At Trivandi, all roles are broad and flexible, but here’s a flavour of where you’ll focus your time: 

 

Strategic Leadership 

Define and deliver the overall vision and strategic roadmap for the Trivandi Academy including: 

  • Academy Leadership & Strategy 
  • Business development, market foothold and client relationships 
  • IP Development including Digital and In-Person Learning Products
  • Learning Programme Delivery 
  • Workforce & Volunteer Training 
  • Executive Coaching 
  • Company Culture & Team Values 
  • Bids and Bid Support 
  • Training Facilities (Internationally and in KSA) 

Collaborate with Trivandi’s leadership to integrate Academy activity with wider strategic goals. 

 

Commercial & Business Development 

  • Be accountable for the commercial performance of Trivandi Academy, including revenue, profitability, and long-term growth. 
  • Lead go-to-market planning for digital products and coaching offers, with robust pricing models. 
  • Support high-impact bids through capability and training strategies, positioning the Academy as a differentiator in our offers. 

 

Programme & Product Delivery 

  • Lead on the development of L&D IP and the delivery of programmes 
  • Oversee where required or collaborate and support with the creation and delivery of digital learning assets and capability frameworks (e.g. ME101). 
  • As a team, ensure the high-quality, scalable delivery of workforce and volunteer training across regions and programmes. 
  • Embed a data-informed approach to learning outcomes and engagement impact. 

 

Client Engagement & Executive Development 

  • Build strategic relationships with clients, oversee programme delivery, quality assurance and client satisfaction on all projects  
  • Represent Trivandi Academy in industry forums, thought leadership, and strategic partnerships. 

 

Internal Culture & Academy Operations 

  • Embed Trivandi’s values and leadership behaviours across all Academy-led activity. 
  • Drive internal engagement through culture campaigns, learning opportunities, and executive development aligned to business priorities. 
  • Lead the establishment and growth of physical training facilities in KSA, in partnership with the local team. 

 

Team Leadership 

  • Build and lead a creative, high-performing team with subject matter expertise across learning, digital, coaching, and operations. 
  • Be an active member of the Strategy and Directors Groups, shaping business-wide conversations.

jobDescription.text:
The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior DevOps Engineer to join our team as a dedicated on-site resource for one of our key clients, a major bank in Riyadh. This is a unique and critical role for a technical expert with deep, hands-on experience in OpenShift, who also possesses excellent communication skills. You will be the face of our company on the ground, acting as the primary technical liaison between the bank and our software development teams.

You will be responsible for ensuring the stability, performance, and operational excellence of a crucial software platform used by the bank. This position requires a blend of advanced DevOps expertise, incident management, and client-facing communication, offering a significant opportunity to influence both the client's success and our product's evolution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Liaison & Communication: Serve as the central technical point of contact on-site, facilitating clear and effective communication between the client (bank) and the core software platform provider (your employer).
  • DevOps & Platform Management: Take technical ownership of the software platform's infrastructure, focusing on CI/CD, automation, and stability. Plan, coordinate, and execute new deployments, upgrades, and patches for the platform.
  • System Health & OpenShift Operations: Proactively monitor system performance, container orchestration, and availability using APM tools to ensure operational excellence and adherence to SLAs. Leverage deep OpenShift knowledge to manage and troubleshoot the container platform environment.
  • Incident & Problem Management: Provide hands-on Level 1 and Level 2 technical support. Lead incident investigations, perform methodical root cause analysis, and manage the bug tracking lifecycle from identification to resolution with the development team.
  • Strategic Technical Contribution: Collaborate with the bank and our internal teams to identify opportunities for infrastructure improvements, automation, and performance tuning to help them maximize the value of the platform.

OpenShift Container Platform (OCP).

  • Strong technical expertise in modern banking systems and architecture.
  • Proficiency in using system monitoring and application performance management (APM) tools.
  • Excellent database skills, including advanced SQL and experience with Oracle databases.
  • Superior communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships and manage stakeholder expectations as a client-facing technical expert.

  • Experience with Nexus Repository Manager.

We’re looking for a deliberate and detail-oriented Digital Marketing Analyst to join our team.

Are you someone who loves to dig in and decipher what the numbers are telling you about how to adjust your strategy? Do you love to find the answer and explain the ‘why’ behind the actions you take? Do you function best when the task requires a structured, methodical approach?

At KWSM, you will be part of a driven, hard-working team, while enjoying the balance of a hybrid schedule and every other Friday off. We take career development seriously, and love to train & promote leaders.

KWSM operates on a 9/80 work schedule. This means we have every other Friday off, allowing us to get more accomplished in fewer days and enjoy three-day weekends every other week. We work a hybrid schedule – 3 days in the office and 2 days at home. We offer health insurance, 401K, paid vacation, 11 paid holidays a year, and many opportunities for internal promotion, mentorship, professional development, and leadership. 

This is a full-time, salaried, hybrid position. (Can be located in any KWSM office – CA, NV, GA)

Your Mission

This high-impact role will focus on building and managing relationships with government agencies, corporate stakeholders, and ecosystem partners. You will serve as a key point of contact for regional business development, investment engagement, and startup support, helping portfolio companies access opportunities across the Orbit ecosystem.  

Your Responsibilities

Drive Results and Insights for Portfolio Companies

  • Cultivate and manage relationships with key Saudi government ministries and public-sector partners. 
  • Build trust-based connections with leading investors to support capital raising.
  • Identify and onboard new investor, corporate, and government contacts into Orbit's CRM system.
  • Attend high-profile events and networking opportunities in the Kingdom to represent Orbit and deepen local partnerships. 
  • Facilitate second meetings between all Saudi-focused Orbit portfolio companies and relevant Saudi corporate customers.
  • Create partnership roadmaps and go-to-market strategies for startups entering the Saudi market. 
  • Support the expansion of Orbit's mentor and investor network in the region.

Be Operationally Excellent 

  • Maintain detailed and organized CRM records of local investors, corporates, and government stakeholders. 
  • Track and report on engagement progress, outcomes, and opportunities across partner pipelines. 
  • Share regular updates on strategic relationship development and capital raising milestones with the Orbit team. 
  • Collaborate with internal investment and program teams to coordinate Saudi-focused business development efforts. 

Engage the Orbit and Local Ecosystem 

  • Serve as Orbit's local ambassador within the Saudi startup and investment ecosystem. 
  • Organize and lead investor showcases, mentor events, and ecosystem meetups across the Kingdom. 
  • Support Orbit's regional positioning by building long-term partnerships that unlock value for startups, founders, and investors. 
  • Help structure visits and programming for Orbit portfolio companies seeking market access and mentorship in Saudi Arabia. 

Your First Days

By Day 30:

  • Become fluent in Orbit's investment thesis, processes and CRM tools. 
  • Meet with key internal stakeholders to align collaboration models, and historical context. 
  • Review existing partnerships and map top-tier target partnerships. 
  • Attend initial ecosystem and investor events as Orbit's representative in the Kingdom. 

By Day 90:

  • Create or optimize partner pitch materials and value propositions for different partner profiles. 
  • Begin outreach to target partners aligned with strategy.
  • Co-create GTM or activation plans for 3 startups entering the region.
  • Create a clear and documented regional partnership pipeline with estimated impact/value.

By Day 180:

  • Have successfully facilitated 10 B2B partnerships for portfolio companies that have reached discussion stage. 
  • Launch and lead regional partnership initiatives and investor engagement campaigns. 
  • Create a partner enablement or onboarding playbook draft. 
  • Have identified and created relationships with a pipeline of regional qualified investors

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Location: Saudi Arabia
Type: Full Time

Your Mission

The Investment Specialist plays a pivotal role supporting program management, deal execution, portfolio management, and company data collection for our Middle East initiatives. You will support investment decisions and program initiatives to improve founder readiness, investor engagement, and ecosystem collaboration. You will build meaningful relationships with founders and partners to ensure they capture value through the Orbit program. This role requires sharp analytical thinking, cross-functional coordination skills, and a deep commitment to founder success and operational excellence.

Your Responsibilities

Drive Results and Insights for Portfolio Companies

  • Conduct comprehensive due diligence on prospective investments, including data gathering, market research, and company analysis.
  • Support new deal signing and manage follow-up timelines.
  • Analyze portfolio performance using financials and key business indicators.
  • Collaborate with founders to develop financial models, identify unsustainable practices, and project future outcomes.

Be Operationally Excellent

  • Onboard founders and maintain accurate data for each startup.
  • Draft program communications, including newsletters and status updates for founders.
  • Document program activities (e.g., photos, attendance, session feedback).
  • Organize digital folders and ensure proper program file management.
  • Oversee program logistics such as calendar scheduling, material preparation, venue setup, A/V coordination, and F&B sourcing.
  • Collect program and portfolio data for internal reporting and tracking systems.
  • Proactively schedule sourcing meetings, write meeting notes, follow up with leads, file sourcing documents, and help drive the investment pipeline to completion.
  • Support the end-to-end deal execution process.
  • Maintain regular communication with the Orbit team on portfolio company updates.

Engage the Orbit and Local Ecosystem 

  • Maintain regular communication with deal sourcing partners and other channels.
  • Help maintain and grow Orbit’s investor network.
  • Organize and lead ecosystem engagement events and investor showcases.
  • Nurture long-term relationships with founders, co-investors, and community partners.
  • Act as a brand ambassador for Orbit Startups in the MENA startup ecosystem.

Your First Days

By Day 30:

  • Understand the onboarding process and file management system
  • Onboarded at least 3 companies
  • Finish and score high on the investment training module
  • Gain a solid understanding of Orbit's investment thesis, portfolio, and internal systems
  • Schedule and manage sourcing calls and meeting notes
  • Begin conducting due diligence on potential investments under guidance

By Day 90:

  • Complete support for an onsite accelerator program.
  • Independently manage the due diligence process for potential investments
  • Develop and maintain relationships with assigned portfolio companies
  • Develop comprehensive financial models and analyses.

By Day 180:

  • Make strategic improvements to onsite program structure and process
  • Serve as initial point of contact accountable for a portfolio of companies
  • Drive end-to-end deal execution processes

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
About the job:

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Sales Specialist to join our team in the contact center industry. This role is pivotal in driving revenue growth by identifying and engaging prospective clients. The ideal candidate will possess a strategic mindset, a deep understanding of contact center services, and exceptional communication and negotiation skills.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Proactively identify and pursue new sales opportunities through various channels, including cold calling, networking, and digital outreach.
  • Conduct comprehensive needs assessments to understand client requirements, providing tailored service recommendations.
  • Collaborate with the sales team to formulate effective sales strategies and campaigns based on market analysis and client feedback.
  • Develop and present customized proposals, negotiating terms and closing sales in alignment with company objectives.
  • Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with existing clients, fostering loyalty and encouraging repeat business.
  • Monitor sales performance metrics and prepare regular reports for management, using insights to refine sales approaches.
  • Stay informed about industry trends, advancements in contact center technology, and best practices to enhance sales effectiveness.
  • Managing a portfolio of accounts to achieve long-term success.
  • Developing a positive relationships & handling client’s needs.

 

Certificates:

  • COPC is preferred.
  • CPSP (Certified Professional Sales Person) is preferred.
  • CSE (Certified Sales Executive) is preferred.
  • PMP is preferred.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Experience: Minimum of 2 years in sales, with a preference for experience in the contact center or business process outsourcing (BPO) sector.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Responsibilities:

  • Cloud Architecture Design: Designing scalable, resilient, and secure cloud architectures based on business requirements and best practices of the chosen cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.).
  • Cloud Infrastructure Provisioning: Deploying and managing cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or ARM templates to ensure consistency and efficiency.
  • Deployment Automation: Implementing automated deployment pipelines (CI/CD) to enable rapid and reliable deployment of applications and services in the cloud environment.
  • Monitoring and Optimization: Setting up monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions to ensure the performance, availability, and cost efficiency of cloud resources. Continuously optimizing cloud infrastructure and costs.
  • Security Management: Implementing security best practices and configuring identity and access management (IAM) policies, encryption, network security, and compliance controls in the cloud environment.
  • Troubleshooting and Incident Response: Responding to and resolving incidents and outages related to cloud infrastructure, applications, and services. Conducting root cause analysis and implementing preventive measures.
  • Backup and Disaster Recovery: Setting up and maintaining backup and disaster recovery solutions to ensure data integrity and business continuity in the event of failures or disasters.
  • Collaboration and Communication: Working closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, operations, and security teams, to ensure alignment and collaboration on cloud projects and initiatives.
  • Documentation and Knowledge Sharing: Documenting cloud architectures, configurations, procedures, and best practices. Sharing knowledge and providing guidance to other team members and stakeholders.
  • Continuous Learning and Innovation: Staying updated with cloud technology trends, new features, and best practices. Evaluating and recommending new tools and technologies to improve cloud infrastructure and processes.
  • Compliance and Governance: Ensuring cloud environments comply with regulatory requirements and internal policies. Implementing governance frameworks and controls to maintain security and compliance.
  • Vendor Management: Managing relationships with cloud service providers (CSPs) and third-party vendors. Evaluating services, negotiating contracts, and optimizing costs.

Skills:

  • Cloud Platforms: Proficiency in working with major cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or others.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience with tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or Azure Resource Manager for provisioning and managing cloud infrastructure.
  • Containerization: Knowledge of container orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying, managing, and scaling containerized applications.
  • Networking: Understanding of cloud networking concepts including VPCs, subnets, DNS, load balancing, and VPNs.
  • Security: Familiarity with cloud security best practices, identity and access management (IAM), encryption methods, and compliance standards.
  • Monitoring and Logging: Ability to set up and utilize monitoring tools like CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, or Stackdriver, and logging solutions such as ELK stack or Cloud Logging.
  • Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash for automating tasks and workflows in the cloud environment.
  • Database Management: Knowledge of cloud database technologies like Amazon RDS, Azure SQL Database, or Google Cloud SQL, including configuration, backup, and scalability.
  • DevOps Practices: Understanding of DevOps principles and practices, including continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and version control systems like Git.
  • Troubleshooting and Problem Solving: Ability to diagnose and resolve issues related to cloud infrastructure, applications, and services.
  • Collaboration and Communication: Effective communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and clients, and for documenting processes and procedures.
  • Continuous Learning: Given the rapid evolution of cloud technologies, a willingness to stay updated with industry trends, new tools, and best practices.

jobDescription.text:
Job Summary:

Balance between coding/automation and operating our systems. This is in order to handle IT operation form software engineering perspective and use software engineering skills as a tool to manage systems, solve problems, and automate operations tasks. As SRE, you will be responsible for availability, latency, performance, efficiency, monitoring, emergency response, and capacity planning.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Understand client requirements and how they translate in application features, and collaborate with a team of IT professionals to set specifications for new applications.
  • Write high quality source code to program complete applications within deadlines, and Perform unit and integration testing, functional and non-functional testing before launch.
  • Apply CI/CD for applications, and GitOps concepts during software development life cycle, and ensure compliance of all regulations (e.g. security, change management, etc.) during SDLC.
  • Build/write software that automate repeated operations tasks.
  • Manage systems logging, monitoring, and alerts, and plan for failure and reduce its impact. Operate and manage system and ensure its reliability, troubleshoot and debug applications, and support escalation. Provide On-Call Support.
  • harden CI/CD process to have more reliable releases and act as enabler for product teams to deliver reliable product faster.
  • Conduct Full-stack troubleshooting skills across network, application, hardware, and other layers. Document incidents and build knowledge base to provide self-service guide and troubleshooting for other engineers. Manage systems incidents and work to prevent it in the future.
  • Build tools and services that enable engineers to deliver operationally mature services in production and help teams with automating tedious tasks and enable them to quickly launch new services.

 

Experience:

  • +4 years of experience in the same field.

 

Competencies (Knowledge, Skills & Abilities):

  • Teamwork.
  • Up to date knowledge of emerging market trends related to Enterprise Solutions.
  • Basic understanding of application architecture.
  • Basic knowledge of web API implementation, management, and security
  • Analytical Skills.
  • Continuously seeks to develop oneself and broaden knowledge and skills.
  • Extensive experience with one or more general purpose programming languages including but not limited to: Java, Go, PHP.
  • Awareness of databases and object storage.
  • Demonstrated ability to debug, fix, and optimize code.
  • Full-stack troubleshooting skills across network, application, hardware, and other layers.
  • Good experience with git and gitOps.
  • Good knowledge of agility and its practices.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Excellent and high communication skills.

jobDescription.title: وصف الوظيفة
jobDescription.text:
نحن نبحث عن مدير حسابات مبيعات ديناميكي وقائم على النتائج للانضمام إلى فريقنا في جدة، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيكون المرشح المثالي مسؤولاً عن تطوير علاقات قوية مع العملاء والحفاظ عليها، ودفع نمو المبيعات، وتحقيق أهداف الإيرادات من خلال تقديم حلول مصممة خصيصاً لتلبية احتياجات عملائنا.

  • تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المبيعات الاستراتيجية لتحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتجاوزها.
  • تحديد فرص الأعمال الجديدة والتنقيب عنها وتأمينها ضمن المناطق المخصصة لها
  • بناء علاقات طويلة الأمد مع العملاء الرئيسيين وتعزيزها من خلال فهم أهداف أعمالهم ومتطلباتهم
  • إجراء عروض توضيحية وعروض تقديمية فعالة للمنتجات لعرض حلولنا
  • التفاوض على اتفاقيات المبيعات وإبرامها، مع ضمان رضا العملاء وولائهم.
  • مراقبة اتجاهات السوق وأنشطة المنافسين وتعليقات العملاء لتكييف الاستراتيجيات
  • التعاون مع فرق العمل متعددة الوظائف لتوفير حلول مخصصة وحل مشكلات العملاء.
  • إعداد تقارير وتوقعات المبيعات المنتظمة وتقديمها للإدارة لمراجعتها
  • البقاء على اطلاع دائم باتجاهات الصناعة وتطورات المنتجات لتقديم توصيات مستنيرة للعملاء

companyDescription.text:
Apex Industrial Services Company is a trusted provider of high-quality industrial solutions, specializing in the procurement and distribution of tools, equipment, and maintenance products for a wide range of sectors, including oil & gas, construction, manufacturing, and utilities. With a commitment to excellence, reliability, and customer satisfaction, Apex delivers tailored supply chain solutions that support the operational needs of clients across the region.

Backed by a team of experienced professionals and strong partnerships with leading global manufacturers, Apex ensures timely delivery, competitive pricing, and technical support that drive efficiency and value in every project. Whether it’s sourcing critical components or managing logistics, Apex is dedicated to powering industry with precision and integrity.

jobDescription.text:

o Process customer orders and ensure timely delivery.
o Coordinate with procurement, logistics, and finance teams for smooth order fulfillment.
2. Customer Interaction & Relationship Management:
o Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, and in-person meetings.
o Maintain relationships with existing clients and assist in acquiring new ones.
3. Data & Report Management:

o Generate sales reports, track targets, and prepare presentations for management.
4. Team Coordination & Process Improvement:
o Work closely with sales managers and representatives to ensure seamless operations.
o Suggest and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
The Liaison Officer will serve as the primary on-the-ground point of contact between a film fund, production companies, investors, and the consulting team managing the fund. This individual will ensure efficient communication, administrative tracking, and strategic support for the day-to-day operations of the fund. They will be responsible for facilitating smooth interactions between all stakeholders and providing project management support to ensure the fund’s successful operation.

Key Responsibilities
1. Communication & Liaison Support
• Act as the primary liaison between Strategy&, investors, production companies, and the fund.
• Facilitate clear and effective communication between all stakeholders, ensuring alignment on objectives and deliverables.
• Provide timely responses to inquiries and requests from investors and production partners.
• Assist in organizing and coordinating meetings, both in-person and virtual, ensuring key stakeholders are informed and prepared.
• Take detailed meeting notes and circulate action items to relevant parties.

2. Administrative & Project Management Support
• Track and manage all low-level administrative and operational tasks related to the fund’s activities.
• Maintain a centralized repository (MS OneDrive) for all documentation, including contracts, financial records, and project updates.
• Monitor project timelines and ensure adherence to deadlines.
• Oversee the reporting of ongoing film production progress and liaise with production companies to collect and verify updates.
• Assist in tracking budgets, actuals, and financial allocations across projects.

3. Strategic Analysis & Reporting

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
A Logistics Operations Supervisor plays a crucial role in overseeing the movement of goods and ensuring efficient supply chain management. Below are the key job responsibilities of a Logistics Operations Supervisor:


1. Oversee and manage logistics staff, including warehouse, coordinators, and support personnel. Provide
leadership, assign tasks, monitor performance, and foster a positive and productive team environment.
2. Train new and existing staff on company policies, safety procedures, and logistics operations. Conduct
periodic training sessions and ensure team members are well-informed of any updates or changes to
processes.
3. Develop and maintain employee schedules, ensuring proper staffing levels to meet operational demands.
Address staffing issues such as absenteeism, overtime, and shift coverage.
4. Monitor and manage the day-to-day activities of the logistics operations, including co-ordination with
suppliers for shipments, receiving, storing, and shipping goods, inventory management, and order
fulfillment.
5. Analyze the efficiency of the logistics processes, identify bottlenecks, and implement improvements to
streamline operations, reduce turnaround time, and increase productivity.
6. Ensure that the goods being handled are accurate, damage-free, and meet quality standards. Enforce strict
checks on inventory and shipments to ensure high-quality standards are maintained.
7. Maintain up-to-date records of inventory levels and movements. Monitor stock levels, reorder points, and
perform regular stock checks to avoid overstocking or stockouts.
8. Ensure that stock rotation principles (FIFO, FEFO, etc.) are followed to reduce spoilage, waste, or
obsolescence, especially for perishable or time-sensitive goods.
9. Perform regular physical inventories and reconcile discrepancies between the system and actual stock
levels. Investigate and resolve inventory issues such as misplaced, lost, or damaged goods.
10. Coordinate and schedule inbound and outbound shipments, customer requirements, and delivery
deadlines. Ensure timely dispatch of goods and track shipments to avoid delays.
11. Liaise with third-party logistics providers (3PL), shipping carriers, and freight forwarders to arrange
transportation. Negotiate rates, establish contracts, and ensure the best carrier options are chosen for
cost and time efficiency.
12. Plan the most efficient routes for transportation to minimize costs and ensure timely deliveries.
13. Continuously assess and evaluate logistics processes to identify inefficiencies, redundancies, and areas for
improvement. Implement new systems or workflows to enhance productivity and reduce costs.
14. Identify and implement strategies to reduce logistics-related costs, such as reducing transportation
expenses, improving packaging methods, or negotiating better rates with suppliers and carriers.

15. Track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to logistics efficiency (e.g., on-time delivery, transportation
costs, inventory turnover, etc.) and ensure the team meets or exceeds targets.
16. Ensure logistics operations comply with local regulations regarding transportation, storage, handling of
goods, and employee safety.
17. Enforce safety policies and guidelines, including proper handling of hazardous materials, safe lifting
techniques, vehicle safety, and emergency response protocols. Ensure that all staff are trained in these
safety procedures.
18. Conduct risk assessments to identify potential hazards in the logistics operations and develop mitigation
strategies to prevent accidents or delays.
19. Communicate with internal and external customers regarding delivery schedules, status updates, and any
issues related to logistics. Ensure that customer complaints are handled quickly and effectively.
20. Ensure that all customer orders are processed accurately, efficiently, and delivered on time. Work with the
sales and support service teams to resolve any order fulfillment issues.
21. Investigate and resolve any logistical issues, including delayed shipments, inventory discrepancies,
damaged goods, or transport accidents. Act swiftly to mitigate the impact on customers and business
operations.
22. Ensure that all required documentation, such as bills of lading, shipping manifests, inventory records, and
regulatory forms, is accurate and filed in a timely manner.
23. Utilizing inhouse system for full business flow cycle (shipping documents / Cargo Insurance - SRV's - DN's –
credit note, etc.
24. Develop and maintain positive relationships with suppliers and service providers, ensuring effective
collaboration and addressing any supply chain disruptions.
In summary, a Logistics Operations Supervisor is responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of all logistics
processes, from managing teams to optimizing inventory levels, coordinating transportation, and continuously
improving efficiency. They play a critical role in maintaining cost-effective, timely, and safe logistics practices
while ensuring customer satisfaction.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Position Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) to join our dynamic team. The HRBP will be responsible for aligning business objectives with employees and management, serving as a consultant to management on human resource-related issues. The successful candidate will act as an employee champion and change agent, assessing and anticipating HR-related needs.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Strategic Partnership:
    • Collaborate with senior management to develop and implement HR strategies that align with business goals.
    • Provide strategic input on workforce planning, organizational design, and talent management.
  2. Employee Relations:
    • Manage and resolve complex employee relations issues.
    • Conduct effective, thorough, and objective investigations.
    • Advise and coach managers on performance management, employee development, and conflict resolution.
  3. Talent Acquisition and Management:
    • Oversee the recruitment process to attract, hire, and retain top talent.
    • Develop and implement talent management strategies to ensure a high-performance culture.
    • Facilitate onboarding and training programs to ensure smooth integration of new hires.
  4. Performance Management:
    • Implement performance appraisal systems and provide guidance on performance improvement plans.
    • Drive the continuous improvement of performance management processes and tools.
  5. Compensation and Benefits:
    • Work with the compensation team to analyze market data and ensure competitive salary structures.
    • Manage and oversee employee benefits programs to ensure alignment with industry standards.
  6. Compliance and Policy Management:
    • Ensure compliance with local labor laws and regulations.
    • Develop, implement, and communicate HR policies and procedures.
    • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of HR best practices and trends.
  7. Government Relations:
    • Serve as the primary liaison between the company and government agencies.
    • Ensure compliance with all government regulations and labor laws.
    • Manage the process for obtaining and renewing necessary licenses, permits, and visas.
    • Stay informed on changes in government policies and regulations that may impact the company.
    • Represent the company in meetings and negotiations with government officials.
  8. HR Analytics and Reporting:
    • Utilize HR metrics to inform decision-making and improve HR processes.
    • Prepare and analyze reports on HR metrics such as turnover, retention, and employee satisfaction.
  9. Culture and Employee Engagement:
    • Promote a positive work environment and foster a culture of collaboration and innovation.
    • Develop and implement employee engagement initiatives to enhance morale and productivity.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Bachelor’s degree in human resources / business administration, or a related field,
  • CIPD / MBA will be an added advantage.
  • 6-8 years of experience in HR, with at least 3 years in a HRBP role.
  • Strong knowledge of HR practices, labor laws, and regulations in Saudi Arabia.
  • Ability to develop and implement HR strategies that align with business goals.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

An amazing opportunity: join a highly creative, multi-disciplined global communications agency and network. What this means: the opportunity to work on some of the best brands in the world, the ability to draw on all the resources of a top global networked agency, and the chance to work in an entrepreneurial environment.

Who do we need?
To be successful in the role, you must have proven skills across planning, creative and strategic thinking, as well as the ability to manage accounts and account teams. You will be a strong leader with excellent writing and communications skills and an ability to translate client needs into project plans. You will also help develop and implement engagement campaigns for a variety of clients. Ideally, you should have agency/consulting or related experience with a background in consumer/destination PR. You are adept at drawing upon previous sector experience to provide clients with knowledge and counsel – all complemented by your sector-specific client servicing skills and media relations with key journalists in both local and regional media.

What will you be doing?

Client Relations:

• Be a key player in supporting the clients at events and activations.

Content development:

New Business:

Account Team Management:

• Assist in financial management for clients, including supplier coordination and activity reports.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Job Title: Recruitment cum Sales Executive

Location: Riyadh, KSA
Job Type: Full-time
Industry: Recruitment & Outsourcing

Job Summary:

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Recruitment cum Sales Executive to join our team in Riyadh, KSA, within the Recruitment & Outsourcing industry. This role combines the responsibilities of recruitment and sales, requiring the candidate to source, attract, and recruit top talent while also generating new business opportunities and building relationships with clients. The ideal candidate must possess a valid driving license, excellent interpersonal skills, a strong sales mindset, and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities:

Recruitment Duties:

  1. Talent Sourcing & Acquisition:

    • Identify, attract, and recruit candidates for open positions across various levels.
    • Post job advertisements and source candidates through job boards, social media platforms, and recruitment agencies.
    • Conduct pre-screening interviews to assess candidate qualifications and fit.
    • Coordinate and conduct interviews, reference checks, and onboarding processes.

  2. Candidate Management:

    • Build and maintain a pipeline of qualified candidates.
    • Develop and maintain relationships with both active and passive candidates.
    • Manage candidate databases, ensuring accurate and updated records.
    • Provide candidates with feedback and updates throughout the recruitment process.

  3. Collaboration:

    • Collaborate with hiring managers to understand their staffing needs and job requirements.
    • Work closely with internal HR teams to ensure timely fulfillment of vacancies.

Sales Duties:

  1. Client Acquisition:

    • Identify potential business opportunities by researching and prospecting for new clients.
    • Develop and maintain relationships with current and potential clients.
    • Generate sales leads through cold calls, networking, and client referrals.

  2. Sales Presentations & Negotiations:

    • Present and sell recruitment and outsourcing services to prospective clients.
    • Negotiate contract terms and close sales deals to achieve sales targets.
    • Regularly follow up with clients to ensure satisfaction and explore new business opportunities.

  3. Sales Strategy:

    • Develop sales strategies to meet the company's sales objectives.
    • Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of industry trends and market conditions.
    • Report on sales activities and achievements to management.

Driving & Mobility:

  1. Client Visits:
    • Conduct regular site visits to client locations for meetings, presentations, and follow-ups.
    • Use personal or company-provided vehicles for transportation to client meetings.
  2. Candidate Site Visits:
    • Travel to various locations to conduct recruitment drives and candidate interviews.
    • Support logistical arrangements for recruitment activities.

 

  • Experience:
    • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in recruitment, sales, or a similar combined role.
    • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Driving License:
    • Valid driving license is mandatory.
    • Willingness to travel locally as part of the role.
  • Skills:
    • Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
    • Ability to manage multiple recruitment processes simultaneously.
    • Familiarity with applicant tracking systems (ATS) and CRM tools.
    • Target-driven with the ability to work under pressure.
  • Other Requirements:
    • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
    • Ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.
    • Knowledge of labor laws and recruitment best practices is a plus.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary plus commission based on performance.
  • Health insurance and other standard company benefits.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
What’s Happening?

We have an exciting opportunity for you to join a highly creative, multi-disciplinary global communications agency and network. This role offers the chance to work with some of the world’s most renowned brands, access the vast resources of a top global networked agency, and thrive in an entrepreneurial environment.

Who Do We Need?

We are seeking a Copywriter/Editor with demonstrated expertise in creating written content for a variety of clients across different sectors. You should be an excellent team player with outstanding English writing and communication skills. Your ability to translate client needs into compelling content that achieves their objectives is crucial. You must be adept at conducting thorough online research to find relevant and up-to-date supporting data and have a talent for quickly identifying the key message in complex documents. You should also be skilled at repurposing approved content by integrating it with current data and news. Your work will be pivotal in driving engagement and meeting KPIs for PR campaigns.

Content Planning and Development:

  • Generate and develop content ideas that drive success in digital/social media and PR campaigns.
  • Create a range of content deliverables from client briefs, or assist in developing client briefs:

    • Short-form PR content: ad hoc quotes for independent news features and social media posts, including thought leadership posts on LinkedIn.
  • Lead the timely delivery of content.

Industry and Market Knowledge:

  • Maintain a deep understanding of clients' businesses and stay informed about developments and trends in their industries.

Account Team Management:

  • Provide guidance and innovative ideas to account teams for implementing and developing client work.

  • Agency background preferred.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
We are looking for a highly skilled and imaginative Bilingual Creative Copywriter to produce engaging and compelling content in English & Arabic. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in developing creative concepts and crafting persuasive copy that resonates with target audiences across various channels and platforms. 

Key Responsibilities: 

  1. Content Creation: 
  • Write clear, concise, and impactful copy for advertisements, marketing campaigns, social media, websites, and other promotional materials in English and Arabic
  • Develop creative concepts and messaging strategies that effectively communicate the client's brand identity and marketing objectives.
  • Adapt tone, style, and messaging to suit different cultural nuances and language preferences.
  1. Translation and Localization: 
  • Translate copy from English to Arabic and vice versa while maintaining accuracy, consistency, and cultural relevance.
  • Localize content for target markets, ensuring that messaging resonates with local audiences and adheres to cultural sensitivities and linguistic conventions.
  1. Collaboration: 
  • Collaborate closely with creative teams, art directors, designers, and account managers to develop integrated marketing campaigns and ensure cohesive messaging across all channels.
  • Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute innovative ideas for campaign concepts, taglines, and storytelling.
  1. Research and Strategy: 
  • Conduct research to understand target audience demographics, preferences, and cultural influences, leveraging insights to inform content development strategies.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in advertising and marketing communications.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Minimum of 1 to 2 years of experience as a copywriter in an advertising agency or creative environment.
  • Exceptional proficiency in English and Arabic with demonstrated writing and translation skills.
  • Strong creative thinking and storytelling abilities, with a portfolio showcasing a diverse range of writing styles and content formats.
  • Social media savvy 
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Saudi national preferred
